+<script>
+    const chatMessages = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
+
+    function executeAction(type) {
+        const start = document.getElementById('dateStart').value;
+        const end = document.getElementById('dateEnd').value;
+
+        let label = "";
+        let filterText = "";
+
+        if (start && end) filterText = ` (del ${start} al ${end})`;
+        else if (start) filterText = ` (desde ${start})`;
+
+        if (type === 'Rendimiento') label = "📊 Analizar Rendimiento" + filterText;
+        if (type === 'Resumen') label = "📅 Resumen General" + filterText;
+        if (type === 'Problemas') label = "🚨 Detectar Problemas" + filterText;
+
+        askAI(label, type, start, end);
+    }
+
+    function askAI(displayText, type, start, end) {
+        addMessage(displayText, 'user');
+        showTypingInfo();
+
+        setTimeout(async () => {
+            removeTypingInfo();
+
+            // Fetch with filters
+            const data = await fetchDashboardData(start, end);
+
+            if (type === 'Rendimiento') respondCompliance(data);
+            else if (type === 'Resumen') respondSummary(data);
+            else if (type === 'Problemas') respondProblems(data);
+
+        }, 1000);
+    }
+
+    // UI Helpers
+    function addMessage(html, type) {
+        const div = document.createElement('div');
+        div.className = `message ${type}`;
+
+        let avatar = '';
+        if (type === 'ai') {
+            avatar = `<div class="ai-avatar" style="width: 32px; height: 32px; font-size: 1rem;">👩‍💼</div>`;
+        }
+
+        div.innerHTML = `
+            ${avatar}
+            <div class="message-content">${html}</div>
+        `;
+
+        chatMessages.appendChild(div);
+        chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
+    }
+
+    function showTypingInfo() {
+        const div = document.createElement('div');
+        div.id = 'typing';
+        div.className = 'typing-indicator';
+        div.innerHTML = '<div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div><div class="dot"></div>';
+        chatMessages.appendChild(div);
+        chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
+    }
+
+    function removeTypingInfo() {
+        const el = document.getElementById('typing');
+        if (el) el.remove();
+    }
+
+    // Data Fetching logic with Dates
+    async function fetchDashboardData(start, end) {
+        try {
+            let url = '/api/dashboard';
+            const params = new URLSearchParams();
+            if (start) params.append('start_date', start);
+            if (end) params.append('end_date', end);
+
+            if (params.toString()) url += '?' + params.toString();
+
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            return await res.json();
+        } catch (e) {
+            return null;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Intent Responses
+    function respondCompliance(data) {
+        if (!data) return addMessage("Lo siento, no pude acceder a los datos.", 'ai');
+
+        let msg = `El cumplimiento de planificación es del <strong>${data.compliance_percentage.toFixed(1)}%</strong>. `;
+
+        if (data.compliance_percentage >= 95) {
+            msg += "<br><br>✅ <strong>Estado Excelente:</strong> La producción está alineada con lo planificado.";
+        } else if (data.compliance_percentage >= 80) {
+            msg += "<br><br>⚠️ <strong>Atención:</strong> Hay un ligero desvío, pero estamos en rangos aceptables.";
+        } else {
+            msg += "<br><br>❌ <strong>Crítico:</strong> Estamos significativamente por debajo del plan.";
+        }
+
+        addMessage(msg, 'ai');
+    }
+
+    function respondSummary(data) {
+        if (!data) return addMessage("Error al cargar datos.", 'ai');
+
+        let table = `
+            <table>
+                <tr><th>Métrica</th><th>Valor</th></tr>
+                <tr><td>Producción Total</td><td>${data.total_production_kg.toFixed(2)} Kg</td></tr>
+                <tr><td>Cajas</td><td>${data.total_production_boxes.toFixed(0)}</td></tr>
+                <tr><td>Unidades</td><td>${data.total_production_units}</td></tr>
+            </table>
+        `;
+
+        addMessage(`Aquí tienes el resumen actualizado de la producción: <br>${table}`, 'ai');
+    }
+
+    function respondProblems(data) {
+        if (!data) return;
+
+        let issues = [];
+        if (data.compliance_percentage < 85) issues.push("Bajo cumplimiento de planificacion");
+        if (data.yield_percentage < 90) issues.push("Rendimiento (Kg/Kg) por debajo del estándar");
+
+        if (issues.length === 0) {
+            addMessage("🎉 No detecto problemas críticos en este momento. La operación fluye con normalidad.", 'ai');
+        } else {
+            addMessage(`He detectado las siguientes anomalías que requieren atención:<br><ul><li>${issues.join('</li><li>')}</li></ul>`, 'ai');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function loadAlerts() {
+        addMessage("🔍 Buscando alertas de análisis de inteligencia...", 'user');
+        showTypingInfo();
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/assistant/alerts');
+            const alerts = await res.json();
+
+            removeTypingInfo();
+
+            if (!alerts || alerts.length === 0) {
+                addMessage("✅ No hay alertas pendientes. Todo está en orden.", 'ai');
+                return;
+            }
+
+            addMessage(`He encontrado <strong>${alerts.length} alertas</strong> que requieren tu atención:`, 'ai');
+
+            // Build Alerts HTML
+            let html = '<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; margin-top: 0.5rem;">';
+
+            alerts.forEach(alert => {
+                let badgeClass = 'badge-ok';
+                let icon = '✅';
+                if (alert.status === 'CRÍTICO' || alert.severity === 'critical' || alert.severity === 'high') {
+                    badgeClass = 'badge-critical';
+                    icon = '⚠️';
+                } else if (alert.status === 'WARNING' || alert.severity === 'medium') {
+                    badgeClass = 'badge-warning';
+                    icon = '🔸';
+                }
+
+                // Items List
+                let itemsList = alert.items.map(i => `<li>${i}</li>`).join('');
+
+                html += `
+                <div class="alert-card">
+                    <div class="alert-header">
+                        <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b;">#${alert.id}</div>
+                        <div class="alert-badge ${badgeClass}">${icon} ${alert.status}</div>
+                    </div>
+                    
+                    <div class="alert-client">${alert.client || 'Cliente Desconocido'}</div>
+                    
+                    <div class="alert-refs">
+                        <span class="ref-badge">📄 ${alert.guide_ref}</span>
+                        ${alert.invoice_ref ? `<span class="ref-badge" style="background:#f1f5f9; color:#64748b;">🧾 ${alert.invoice_ref}</span>` : ''}
+                    </div>
+                    
+                    <div class="alert-items">
+                        <strong>Resumen de Ítems:</strong>
+                        <ul style="margin: 0.25rem 0 0 1.2rem; padding: 0;">${itemsList}</ul>
+                    </div>
+                    
+                    <button class="toggle-btn" onclick="toggleDesc('desc-${alert.id}', this)">⬇️ Ver Descripción Completa</button>
+                    
+                    <div id="desc-${alert.id}" class="alert-desc-container">
+                        <div class="alert-desc-title">ANÁLISIS DE INTELIGENCIA:</div>
+                        <div class="alert-desc-text">${alert.description || 'Sin descripción detallada.'}</div>
+                    </div>
+                    
+                    <div style="text-align: right; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; margin-top: 0.5rem;">
+                        ${alert.date}
+                    </div>
+                </div>`;
+            });
+

+            div.innerHTML = `
+                <div class="ai-avatar" style="width: 32px; height: 32px; font-size: 1rem;">👩‍💼</div>
+                <div class="message-content" style="background: transparent; padding: 0; box-shadow: none; width: 100%; max-width: 100%;">${html}</div>
+            `;
+            chatMessages.appendChild(div);
+            // Scroll to bottom
+            chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            removeTypingInfo();
+            console.error(e);
+            addMessage("❌ Error al cargar las alertas.", 'ai');
+        }
+    }
+
+    function toggleDesc(id, btn) {
+        const el = document.getElementById(id);
+        if (el.style.display === 'block') {
+            el.style.display = 'none';
+            btn.innerHTML = '⬇️ Ver Descripción Completa';
+        } else {
+            el.style.display = 'block';
+            btn.innerHTML = '⬆️ Ocultar Descripción';
+        }

+    // ── AI Supervisor Diagnostics ──────────────────────────────
+    async function refreshAIDiagnostics() {
+        const container = document.getElementById('ai-supervisor-section');
+        const list = document.getElementById('ai-issues-container');
+        const cleanMsg = document.getElementById('ai-clean-state');
+
+        list.innerHTML = '<div style="opacity: 0.7; color: white;">Analizando base de datos...</div>';
+        cleanMsg.style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/diagnose');
+            const issues = await res.json();
+
+            list.innerHTML = '';
+
+            if (issues.length === 0) {
+                cleanMsg.style.display = 'flex';
+            } else {
+                issues.forEach(issue => {
+                    const div = document.createElement('div');
+                    div.style.cssText = `
+                        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
+                        color: #1e293b;
+                        padding: 1rem;
+                        border-radius: 8px;
+                        display: flex;
+                        justify-content: space-between;
+                        align-items: center;
+                        gap: 1rem;
+                        border-left: 4px solid #ef4444;
+                    `;
+                    div.innerHTML = `
+                        <div>
+                            <div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.95rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;">
+                                ⚠️ ${issue.title}
+                                <span style="background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;">${issue.severity}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b; margin-top: 0.25rem;">${issue.description}</div>
+                        </div>
+                    `;
+                    list.appendChild(div);
+                });
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            list.innerHTML = '<div style="color: #fca5a5;">Error de conexión con el servicio AI.</div>';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function fixIssue(id, type, btn) {
+        const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+        btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Procesando...';
+        btn.disabled = true;
+        btn.style.opacity = 0.7;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/fix', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify({ id, type })
+            });
+
+            const result = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                btn.innerHTML = '✅ Corregido';
+                btn.style.background = '#22c55e';
+                setTimeout(() => { refreshAIDiagnostics(); }, 1500);
+            } else {
+                alert("Error: " + result.detail);
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+                btn.style.opacity = 1;
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error de red");
+            btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Auto-escanear al cargar
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        refreshAIDiagnostics();
+    });
+    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+    async function sendUserChat() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('userMessage');
+        const msg = input.value.trim();
+        if (!msg) return;
+
+        addMessage(msg, 'user');
+        input.value = '';
+        showTypingInfo();
+
+        try {
+            const formData = new FormData();
+            formData.append('message', msg);
+
+            const res = await fetch('/api/assistant/chat', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            removeTypingInfo();
+            addMessage(data.response, 'ai');
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            removeTypingInfo();
+            addMessage("❌ Error de conexión.", 'ai');
+        }
+    }

+<script>
+    let historyChartInstance = null;
+    let pieChartInstance = null;
+
+    async function loadDashboard() {
+        const start = document.getElementById('startDate').value;
+        const end = document.getElementById('endDate').value;
+        let url = '/api/dashboard';
+
+        const params = new URLSearchParams();
+        if (start) params.append('start_date', start);
+        if (end) params.append('end_date', end);
+
+        if (params.toString()) url += '?' + params.toString();
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error fetching stats');
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            // KPIs
+            document.getElementById('compliancePct').textContent = data.compliance_percentage.toFixed(1);
+            document.getElementById('yieldPct').textContent = data.yield_percentage.toFixed(1);
+            document.getElementById('wastePct').textContent = data.waste_percentage.toFixed(2);
+            document.getElementById('wasteKg').textContent = data.total_waste_kg.toFixed(2);
+            document.getElementById('avgKgBatch').textContent = data.avg_kg_per_batch.toFixed(1);
+            document.getElementById('quickConsPct').textContent = data.quick_consumption_percentage.toFixed(1);
+
+            // Production Stats
+            document.getElementById('prodBatches').textContent = data.total_production_batches;
+            document.getElementById('prodKg').textContent = data.total_production_kg.toFixed(2);
+            document.getElementById('prodUnits').textContent = data.total_production_units;
+
+            // Planning Stats
+            document.getElementById('planBatches').textContent = data.total_planned_batches;
+            document.getElementById('planKg').textContent = data.total_planned_kg.toFixed(2);
+            document.getElementById('planUnits').textContent = data.total_planned_units;
+
+            // --- Render Charts ---
+
+            // 1. Pie Chart
+            const pieCtx = document.getElementById('pieChart').getContext('2d');
+            if (pieChartInstance) pieChartInstance.destroy();
+
+            const pieLabels = data.pie_data.map(d => d.label);
+            const pieValues = data.pie_data.map(d => d.value);
+
+            pieChartInstance = new Chart(pieCtx, {
+                type: 'doughnut',
+                data: {
+                    labels: pieLabels,
+                    datasets: [{
+                        data: pieValues,
+                        backgroundColor: [
+                            '#4a90e2', '#50e3c2', '#b8e986', '#f5a623', '#d0021b', '#9b9b9b'
+                        ]
+                    }]
+                },
+                options: {
+                    responsive: true,
+                    plugins: {
+                        legend: { position: 'bottom' }
+                    }
+                }
+            });
+
+            // 2. History Chart (Bar vs Line)
+            const historyCtx = document.getElementById('historyChart').getContext('2d');
+            if (historyChartInstance) historyChartInstance.destroy();
+
+            const histDates = data.history_data.map(d => d.date);
+            const histProduced = data.history_data.map(d => d.produced);
+            const histPlanned = data.history_data.map(d => d.planned);
+
+            historyChartInstance = new Chart(historyCtx, {
+                type: 'bar',
+                data: {
+                    labels: histDates,
+                    datasets: [
+                        {
+                            label: 'Producido (Kg)',
+                            data: histProduced,
+                            backgroundColor: '#4a90e2',
+                            order: 2
+                        },
+                        {
+                            label: 'Planificado (Kg)',
+                            data: histPlanned,
+                            type: 'line', // Line overlay to show target
+                            borderColor: '#d0021b',
+                            borderWidth: 2,
+                            fill: false,
+                            tension: 0.1,
+                            order: 1
+                        }
+                    ]
+                },
+                options: {
+                    responsive: true,
+                    interaction: {
+                        mode: 'index',
+                        intersect: false,
+                    }
+                }
+            });
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function clearFilter() {
+        document.getElementById('startDate').value = '';
+        document.getElementById('endDate').value = '';
+        loadDashboard();
+    }
+
+    // Date Validation Logic
+    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+    // First day of current month
+    const dateObj = new Date();
+    const firstDay = new Date(dateObj.getFullYear(), dateObj.getMonth(), 1).toISOString().split('T')[0];
+
+    const dateStart = document.getElementById('startDate');
+    const dateEnd = document.getElementById('endDate');
+
+    // Set default if empty (Month to Date)
+    if (!dateStart.value) dateStart.value = firstDay;
+    if (!dateEnd.value) dateEnd.value = today;
+
+    function validateDateRange() {
+        if (dateStart.value && dateEnd.value && dateStart.value > dateEnd.value) {
+            alert("Fecha inválida: La fecha final no puede ser menor a la inicial.");
+            dateEnd.value = dateStart.value;
+        }
+    }
+
+    dateStart.addEventListener('change', validateDateRange);
+    dateEnd.addEventListener('change', validateDateRange);
+
+    // AI Supervisor Logic
+    async function refreshAIDiagnostics() {
+        const container = document.getElementById('ai-supervisor-section');
+        const list = document.getElementById('ai-issues-container');
+        const cleanMsg = document.getElementById('ai-clean-state');
+
+        // Show section
+        container.style.display = 'block';
+        list.innerHTML = '<div style="opacity: 0.7;">Analizando base de datos...</div>';
+        cleanMsg.style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/diagnose');
+            const issues = await res.json();
+
+            list.innerHTML = '';
+
+            if (issues.length === 0) {
+                cleanMsg.style.display = 'flex';
+            } else {
+                issues.forEach(issue => {
+                    const div = document.createElement('div');
+                    div.style.cssText = `
+                        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
+                        color: #1e293b;
+                        padding: 1rem;
+                        border-radius: 8px;
+                        display: flex;
+                        justify-content: space-between;
+                        align-items: center;
+                        gap: 1rem;
+                        border-left: 4px solid #ef4444;
+                    `;
+
+                    div.innerHTML = `
+                        <div>
+                            <div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.95rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;">
+                                ⚠️ ${issue.title}
+                                <span style="background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;">${issue.severity}</span>
+                            </div>
+                            <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b; margin-top: 0.25rem;">${issue.description}</div>
+                        </div>
+                        <button onclick="fixIssue('${issue.id}', '${issue.type}', this)" 
+                            style="background: #dc2626; color: white; border: none; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 0.2s;">
+                            ✨ Corregir con AI
+                        </button>
+                    `;
+                    list.appendChild(div);
+                });
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            list.innerHTML = '<div style="color: #fca5a5;">Error de conexión con el servicio AI.</div>';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function fixIssue(id, type, btn) {
+        const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+        btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Procesando...';
+        btn.disabled = true;
+        btn.style.opacity = 0.7;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/ai/stock/fix', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify({ id, type })
+            });
+
+            const result = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                btn.innerHTML = '✅ Corregido';
+                btn.style.background = '#22c55e';
+                setTimeout(() => {
+                    // Refresh checks
+                    refreshAIDiagnostics();
+                }, 1500);
+            } else {
+                alert("Error: " + result.detail);
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+                btn.style.opacity = 1;
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error de red");
+            btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+            btn.disabled = false;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Auto-load AI Supervisor
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        refreshAIDiagnostics();
+    });
+
+    loadDashboard();
+</script>
 {% endblock %}

+<script>
+    let currentView = 'inbox'; // inbox, starred, history
+
+    async function loadChannels() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/discuss/api/channels');
+            const data = await res.json();
+            const list = document.getElementById('channelsList');
+            list.innerHTML = '';
+            data.forEach(c => {
+                const div = document.createElement('div');
+                div.className = 'discuss-nav-item';
+                div.innerHTML = `<span style="color: #714B67; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 8px;">#</span> ${c.name}`;
+                div.onclick = () => { alert('Channel view not fully implemented yet, showing Inbox for demo'); loadMessages('inbox'); };
+                list.appendChild(div);
+            });
+        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
+    }
+    loadChannels();
+
+    async function loadMessages(view) {
+        currentView = view;
+
+        // Update Title
+        const labels = { 'inbox': '📥 Bandeja de entrada', 'starred': '⭐ Destacado', 'history': '🕒 Historial' };
+        document.getElementById('currentViewTitle').textContent = labels[view];
+
+        // Update Sidebar Active
+        document.querySelectorAll('.discuss-nav-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
+        const navId = 'nav-' + view;
+        const navEl = document.getElementById(navId);
+        if (navEl) navEl.classList.add('active');
+
+        // Fetch
+        const container = document.getElementById('messageContainer');
+        container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:20px; text-align:center;">Cargando...</div>';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/discuss/api/messages/${view}`);
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            container.innerHTML = '';
+            if (data.length === 0) {
+                container.innerHTML = `
+                    <div style="display: flex; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; color: #666;">
+                        <div style="font-size: 4rem; opacity: 0.2; margin-bottom: 20px;">${view === 'starred' ? '⭐' : '📥'}</div>
+                        <h3 style="margin: 0; color: #444;">${view === 'inbox' ? 'Bandeja vacía' : 'Sin mensajes'}</h3>
+                        <p style="color: #888; margin-top: 10px;">¡Estás al día!</p>
+                    </div>`;
+                return;
+            }
+
+            data.forEach(msg => {
+                const item = document.createElement('div');
+                item.className = 'message-item';
+
+                // Avatar
+                const avatar = `<img src="https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${msg.author}&background=random" style="width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%;">`;
+
+                // Star Class
+                const starClass = msg.is_starred ? 'starred' : '';
+
+                // Actions based on view
+                let actionsHtml = '';
+                if (view === 'inbox') {
+                    actionsHtml += `<span class="action-icon" onclick="markRead(${msg.id})" title="Marcar como leído">✓</span>`;
+                }
+                actionsHtml += `<span class="action-icon ${starClass}" onclick="toggleStar(${msg.id})" title="Destacar">★</span>`;
+
+                item.innerHTML = `
+                    ${avatar}
+                    <div style="flex: 1;">
+                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline;">
+                            <strong style="font-size: 0.95rem; color: #333;">${msg.author}</strong>
+                            <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #888;">${msg.full_date} en <strong>${msg.channel}</strong></span>
+                        </div>
+                        <div style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #444; margin-top: 4px;">
+                            ${msg.body}
+                        </div>
+                    </div>
+                    <div class="message-actions">
+                        ${actionsHtml}
+                    </div>
+                `;
+                container.appendChild(item);
+            });
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            container.innerHTML = 'Error loading messages';
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Initial Load
+    loadMessages('inbox');
+
+    // Actions
+    async function markRead(id) {
+        await fetch(`/discuss/api/message/${id}/mark_read`, { method: 'POST' });
+        loadMessages(currentView); // Refresh
+    }
+
+    async function toggleStar(id) {
+        await fetch(`/discuss/api/message/${id}/star`, { method: 'POST' });
+        loadMessages(currentView); // Refresh
+    }
+
+    async function postMessage(e) {
+        e.preventDefault();
+        const body = document.getElementById('postBody').value;
+        const channelId = document.getElementById('postChannelId').value;
+
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        fd.append('body', body);
+        fd.append('channel_id', channelId);
+
+        await fetch('/discuss/api/message', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+        document.getElementById('postBody').value = '';
+        loadMessages(currentView);
+    }
+</script>
 {% endblock %}

+<script>
+    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
+
+    // Init Date
+    $('headerDate').value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+
+    // Tabs Logic
+    function switchTab(tabName) {
+        // Toggle Headers
+        document.querySelectorAll('.o_notebook_tab').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
+        if (tabName === 'lines') document.querySelectorAll('.o_notebook_tab')[0].classList.add('active');
+        if (tabName === 'info') document.querySelectorAll('.o_notebook_tab')[1].classList.add('active');
+
+        // Toggle Content
+        $('tab-lines').style.display = tabName === 'lines' ? 'block' : 'none';
+        $('tab-info').style.display = tabName === 'info' ? 'block' : 'none';
+    }
+
+    // State
+    let currentLines = [];
+
+    // --- Reuse Search Logic ---
+    let articlesData = [];
+    async function loadArticles() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/external/articles');
+            if (res.ok) articlesData = await res.json();
+        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
+    }
+    loadArticles();
+
+    const searchInput = $('articleSearch');
+    const resultsDiv = $('articleResults');
+    const bInput = $('batchInput');
+
+    searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+        const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
+        if (term.length < 1) { resultsDiv.style.display = 'none'; return; }
+        const filtered = articlesData.filter(a => a.description.toLowerCase().includes(term) || a.code.toLowerCase().includes(term));
+        if (filtered.length > 0) {
+            resultsDiv.innerHTML = '';
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
+            filtered.forEach(item => {
+                const div = document.createElement('div');
+                div.style.padding = '8px'; div.style.cursor = 'pointer'; div.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #eee';
+                div.textContent = `${item.code} - ${item.description}`;
+                div.onclick = () => {
+                    searchInput.value = item.description;
+                    $('articleCodeHidden').value = item.code;
+                    $('articleDescHidden').value = item.description;
+                    resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+                    bInput.focus();
+                };
+                div.onmouseover = () => div.style.background = '#f8f9fa';
+                div.onmouseout = () => div.style.background = 'white';
+                resultsDiv.appendChild(div);
+            });
+        } else { resultsDiv.style.display = 'none'; }
+    });
+    // Enter key to add line logic
+    $('qtyInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
+        if (e.key === 'Enter') addLine();
+    });
+    document.addEventListener('click', e => { if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsDiv.contains(e.target)) resultsDiv.style.display = 'none'; });
+
+    // --- Line Logic ---
+    function addLine() {
+        const code = $('articleCodeHidden').value;
+        const desc = $('articleDescHidden').value || searchInput.value; // Fallback if user typed manually (dangerous but flexible)
+        const batch = $('batchInput').value;
+        const qty = parseFloat($('qtyInput').value);
+
+        if (!desc || !qty || qty <= 0) {
+            // Subtle shake or red border? For now alert
+            // alert("Info Incompleta");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        currentLines.push({ article_code: code || 'MANUAL', article_description: desc, batch: batch || 'S/L', quantity: qty });
+        renderLines();
+
+        // Reset inputs
+        searchInput.value = '';
+        $('articleCodeHidden').value = '';
+        $('articleDescHidden').value = '';
+        $('batchInput').value = '';
+        $('qtyInput').value = '';
+        searchInput.focus();
+    }
+
+    function removeLine(index) {
+        currentLines.splice(index, 1);
+        renderLines();
+    }
+
+    function renderLines() {
+        const tbody = $('linesTableBody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        currentLines.forEach((line, idx) => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td>${line.article_description} <span style="color:#888; font-size:0.8rem;">[${line.article_code}]</span></td>
+                <td>${line.batch}</td>
+                <td style="text-align: right;">${line.quantity.toFixed(2)}</td>
+                <td style="text-align: center;">
+                    <span onclick="removeLine(${idx})" style="cursor: pointer; color: #dc3545; font-size: 1.1rem;" title="Eliminar">&times;</span>
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }
+
+    // --- Save Logic ---
+    async function saveFullCapture() {
+        if (currentLines.length === 0) {
+            alert("Agregue al menos una línea.");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const payload = {
+            date: $('headerDate').value,
+            notes: $('headerNotes').value + " | Tipo: " + $('opType').value,
+            lines: currentLines
+        };
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/inventory/api/full-capture', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                $('correlativeDisplay').textContent = data.correlative;
+                $('successModal').style.display = 'flex';
+            } else {
+                alert("Error al guardar.");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error de conexión.");
+        }
+    }
+</script>
+
 {% endblock %}

+    <script>
+        // Discuss Logic
+        async function toggleDiscussDropdown() {
+            const dropdown = document.getElementById('discussDropdown');
+            const isVisible = dropdown.style.display === 'block';
+            dropdown.style.display = isVisible ? 'none' : 'block';
+
+            if (!isVisible) {
+                await fetchRecentMessages();
+            }
+        }
+
+        async function fetchRecentMessages() {
+            try {
+                const res = await fetch('/discuss/api/messages/recent');
+                const data = await res.json();
+                const list = document.getElementById('discussList');
+                list.innerHTML = '';
+
+                if (data.length === 0) {
+                    list.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 15px; text-align: center; color: #888;">¡Estás al día!</div>';
+                    return;
+                }
+
+                data.forEach(msg => {
+                    const item = document.createElement('div');
+                    item.style.padding = '10px 15px';
+                    item.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #f0f0f0';
+                    item.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                    item.onmouseover = () => item.style.background = '#f2f6f8';
+                    item.onmouseout = () => item.style.background = 'white';
+
+                    // Icon logic based on type could be enhanced. Using generic Odoo style
+                    let iconHtml = '<div style="background: #e9ecef; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #666; font-size: 0.8rem;">?</div>';
+
+                    if (msg.type === 'notification') {
+                        iconHtml = '<div style="background: #fff4e5; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #f0ad4e; font-size: 1rem;">⚠️</div>';
+                    } else if (msg.author === 'Sistema') {
+                        iconHtml = '<div style="background: #d1ecf1; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #0c5460; font-size: 1rem;">🤖</div>';
+                    } else {
+                        iconHtml = `<img src="https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${msg.author}&background=random" style="width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%;">`;
+                    }
+
+                    item.innerHTML = `
+                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start;">
+                            ${iconHtml}
+                            <div style="flex: 1;">
+                                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline;">
+                                    <strong style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #333;">${msg.channel}</strong>
+                                    <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #888;">${msg.date}</span>
+                                </div>
+                                <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #444; margin-top: 2px; font-weight: 500;">
+                                    ${msg.author}: <span style="font-weight: 400; color: #666;">${msg.body}</span>
+                                </div>
+                            </div>
+                        </div>
+                    `;
+                    list.appendChild(item);
+                });
+
+            } catch (e) {
+                console.error(e);
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Close dropdown when clicking outside
+        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+            const dropdown = document.getElementById('discussDropdown');
+            const trigger = document.querySelector('[onclick="toggleDiscussDropdown()"]');
+            if (dropdown && dropdown.style.display === 'block') {
+                if (!dropdown.contains(e.target) && !trigger.contains(e.target)) {
+                    dropdown.style.display = 'none';
+                }
+            }
+        });
+
+        // Simple active link highlighter
+        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(link => {
+            if (link.getAttribute('href') === window.location.pathname) {
+                link.classList.add('active');
+            }
+        });
+
+
+        // Sidebar Toggle
+        function toggleSidebar() {
+            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
+            const overlay = document.querySelector('.sidebar-overlay');
+
+            if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
+                // Mobile Logic
+                sidebar.classList.toggle('expanded-mobile');
+                overlay.classList.toggle('active');
+            } else {
+                // Desktop Logic
+                sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
+                // Save preference
+                localStorage.setItem('sidebarState', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed') ? 'collapsed' : 'expanded');
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Restore sidebar state
+        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+            const state = localStorage.getItem('sidebarState');
+            // Default: 'collapsed' if null (Prodio style) or explicitly 'collapsed'
+            if (window.innerWidth > 768 && (state === 'collapsed' || state === null)) {
+                document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
+            }
+
+            // Expand active section by default
+            const activeLink = document.querySelector('.nav-link.active');
+            if (activeLink) {
+                const parentContent = activeLink.closest('.nav-section-content');
+                if (parentContent) {
+                    parentContent.style.display = 'block';
+                    const title = parentContent.parentElement.querySelector('.nav-section-title');
+                    if (title) title.classList.add('expanded');
+                }
+            }
+        });
+
+        // Sidebar Navigation Logic
+        function toggleNavSection(header) {
+            const content = header.nextElementSibling;
+            const isExpanded = content.style.display === 'block';
+
+            // Toggle
+            content.style.display = isExpanded ? 'none' : 'block';
+            header.classList.toggle('expanded', !isExpanded);
+        }
+    </script>
+    <div class="sidebar-overlay" onclick="toggleSidebar()"></div>
+    {% block scripts %}{% endblock %}

+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/logistics/api/routes?t=' + new Date().getTime());
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const routes = await res.json();
+                const select = document.getElementById('routeSelect');
+                const currentVal = select.value;
+                select.innerHTML = '<option value="">Seleccione una Ruta...</option>';
+                routes.forEach(r => {
+                    const option = document.createElement('option');
+                    option.value = r.id;
+                    option.textContent = r.name;
+                    select.appendChild(option);
+                });
+                if (currentVal) select.value = currentVal;
+
+                // DEBUG: Verify routes loaded
+                if (routes.length === 0) {
+                    console.warn("No routes returned from API");
+                } else {
+                    console.log("Loaded " + routes.length + " routes.");
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (e) { console.error("Error loading routes", e); }

+    async function searchInvoice() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('invoiceInput');
+        let val = input.value.trim();
+
+        if (val.includes(' - ')) {
+            val = val.split(' - ')[0].trim();
+        }
+
+        const docNum = val;
+        if (!docNum) return;
+
+        const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('importedInvoices');
+        const currentInvoices = hiddenInput.value ? hiddenInput.value.split(',') : [];
+
+        // Use prefix to uniqueness
+        const prefix = currentDocType === 'invoice' ? 'FACT' : 'NOTA';
+        const storedValue = `${prefix}:${docNum}`;
+
+        if (currentInvoices.includes(storedValue)) {
+            alert(`${currentDocType === 'invoice' ? 'Esta factura' : 'Esta nota'} ya está en la lista actual.`);
+            return;
+        }
+
+        input.disabled = true;
+
+        try {
+            const endpoint = currentDocType === 'invoice'
+                ? `/logistics/api/external/invoice/${encodeURIComponent(docNum)}/items`
+                : `/logistics/api/external/delivery_note/${encodeURIComponent(docNum)}/items`;
+
+            const res = await fetch(endpoint);
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (data.error) {
+                alert(data.error);
+                input.disabled = false;
+                return;
+            }
+            if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
+                alert(`${currentDocType === 'invoice' ? 'Factura no encontrada' : 'Nota de entrega no encontrada'} o sin ítems pendientes.`);
+                input.disabled = false;
+                return;
+            }
+
+            if (items.length === 1 && !items[0].item && !items[0].qty) {
+                items = [];
+            }
+
+            const totalAmount = data[0].invoice_total || 0;
+            const clientName = data[0].client_name || '';
+
+            data.forEach(invItem => {
+                items.push({
+                    client: clientName,
+                    fact: invItem.fact_num,
+                    item: invItem.art_des,
+                    qty: invItem.total_articulo,
+                    unit: invItem.co_uni || 'Unid',
+                    total_cajas: invItem.total_cajas,
+                    unidad_cajas: invItem.unidad_cajas,
+                    num_lote: invItem.num_lote,
+                    invoice_total: totalAmount
+                });
+            });
+
+            currentInvoices.push(storedValue);
+            hiddenInput.value = currentInvoices.join(',');
+
+            // Pass just the list, updateBadges parses it
+            updateBadges(currentInvoices);
+
+            // Assume renderItems or similar exists. 
+            // In typical flow we modify 'items' then user might see updates if Vue/React, 
+            // but this is vanilla JS.
+            // I'll ensure I call renderItems() or addItemRow() (if logic adds there).
+            // Actually, based on previous code reading, `items` is just an array, logic needs to re-render table.
+            renderItems();
+
+            input.value = '';
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error consultando documento");
+        } finally {
+            input.disabled = false;
+            input.focus();
+        }
+    }
+
+    function updateBadges(invoices) {
+        const badgeContainer = document.getElementById('invoiceBadges');
+        badgeContainer.innerHTML = '';
+        invoices.forEach(val => {
+            let type = 'Fact.';
+            let cleanNum = val;
+
+            if (val.includes(':')) {
+                const parts = val.split(':');
+                if (parts[0] === 'NOTA') type = 'Nota';
+                cleanNum = parts[1];
+            } else {
+                // Determine inferred type if no prefix? (Legacy support)
+                // Assume Fact if raw number.
+            }
+
+            const span = document.createElement('span');
+            span.style.background = '#e0f2fe';
+            span.style.color = '#0369a1';
+            span.style.padding = '2px 8px';
+            span.style.borderRadius = '4px';
+            span.style.fontSize = '0.8rem';
+            span.style.display = 'flex';
+            span.style.alignItems = 'center';
+            span.style.gap = '4px';
+
+            // Pass 'val' (prefixed) to removeInvoice
+            span.innerHTML = `<strong>${type}</strong> ${cleanNum} <span onclick="removeInvoice('${val}')" style="cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; color: #0284c7; margin-left: 4px;">&times;</span>`;
+
+            badgeContainer.appendChild(span);
+        });
+    }

+    function removeInvoice(val) {
+        const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('importedInvoices');
+        let list = hiddenInput.value ? hiddenInput.value.split(',') : [];
+        list = list.filter(i => i !== val);
+        hiddenInput.value = list.join(',');
+
+        let cleanNum = val;
+        if (val.includes(':')) cleanNum = val.split(':')[1];
+
+        // Remove items
+        items = items.filter(i => i.fact !== cleanNum);
+        renderItems();
+        updateBadges(list);
+    }

+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">

+                        ${item.fact || 'Manual'}

+                    ${breakdownHtml}
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <input type="number" step="0.01" value="${item.qty}" onchange="updateItem(${index}, 'qty', parseFloat(this.value))"

+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <select onchange="updateItem(${index}, 'unit', this.value)"
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 0.25rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);">
+                        <option value="Unid" ${item.unit === 'Unid' ? 'selected' : ''}>Unid</option>
+                        <option value="Kg" ${item.unit === 'Kg' ? 'selected' : ''}>Kg</option>
+                        <option value="Cjas" ${item.unit === 'Cjas' ? 'selected' : ''}>Cajas</option>
+                        <option value="Lts" ${item.unit === 'Lts' ? 'selected' : ''}>Litros</option>
+                        <option value="${item.unit}" ${['Unid', 'Kg', 'Cjas', 'Lts'].includes(item.unit) ? '' : 'selected'}>${item.unit}</option>
+                    </select>
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem; text-align: center;">

+                        &times;
+                    </button>
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);

+    // --- Annulment Logic ---
+    async function annulDispatch(id, ref) {
+        if (!confirm(`⚠️ ALERTA ⚠️\n\n¿Estás seguro de que deseas ANULAR la guía ${ref}?\n\n- Esta acción no se puede deshacer.\n- Todas las facturas o notas contenidas volverán a estar disponibles de inmediato.\n\nEscribe "ANULAR" para confirmar:`)) return;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/logistics/api/dispatch/${id}/annul`, {
+                method: 'POST'
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                alert(data.message);
+                location.reload(); // Reload to refresh list and annulled states
+            } else {
+                alert(data.detail || "Error anulando la guía.");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error de conexión al anular.");
+        }
+    }
+
+    function removeItem(index) {
+        items.splice(index, 1);
+        renderItems();

+
+        // Validation
+        const validItems = items.filter(i => i.item.trim() !== '' && i.qty > 0);
+
+        if (validItems.length === 0) {
+            alert("⚠️ Por favor agrega al menos un ítem válido (Nombre y Cantidad > 0).");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const formData = new FormData(e.target);
+        // We only send valid items
+        formData.append('items', JSON.stringify(validItems));
+
+        try {
+            // Button is now outside the form, connected via form attribute
+            const btn = document.querySelector('button[form="dispatchForm"]');
+            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+            btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Guardando...';
+            btn.disabled = true;
+
+            const res = await fetch('/logistics/dispatch', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                showSuccessModal(data.document_ref);
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+            } else {
+                // Try to get error detail
+                try {
+                    const errData = await res.json();
+                    console.error("Error Saving:", errData);
+
+                    let msg = "Error desconocido.";
+
+                    if (errData.detail) {
+                        if (typeof errData.detail === 'string') {
+                            msg = errData.detail;
+                        } else if (Array.isArray(errData.detail)) {
+                            // Pydantic styled errors
+                            msg = errData.detail.map(e => `${e.loc ? e.loc.join('.') : ''}: ${e.msg}`).join('\n');
+                        } else {
+                            // Object or other
+                            msg = JSON.stringify(errData.detail, null, 2);
+                        }
+                    } else {
+                        msg = JSON.stringify(errData, null, 2);
+                    }
+
+                    alert("❌ " + msg);
+                } catch (e) {
+                    console.error(e);
+                    alert("❌ Error al procesar la respuesta del servidor.");
+                }
+
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+            }
+        } catch (err) {
+            console.error(err);
+            alert("Error de conexión con el servidor.");
+        }
+    });
+
+    // Summary Modal Logic
+    function showSuccessModal(guideRef) {
+        if (guideRef) {
+            document.getElementById('successGuideRef').textContent = "Nro. Guía: " + guideRef;
+        }
+        document.getElementById('successModal').style.display = 'flex';
+    }
+
+    function closeSuccessAndReload() {
+        window.location.reload();
+    }
+
+    // --- Search & Print Logic ---
+    function filterLogs() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('logSearch');
+        const filter = input.value.toLowerCase();
+        const list = document.getElementById('logList');
+        const items = list.getElementsByClassName('log-item');
+
+        for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
+            const item = items[i];
+            const ref = (item.getAttribute('data-ref') || '').toLowerCase();
+            const date = (item.getAttribute('data-date') || '').toLowerCase();
+            const text = item.textContent.toLowerCase();
+
+            if (ref.includes(filter) || date.includes(filter) || text.includes(filter)) {
+                item.style.display = "";
+            } else {
+                item.style.display = "none";
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    function printDispatch(id) {
+        // Open print view in new window
+        const width = 800;
+        const height = 600;
+        const left = (screen.width - width) / 2;
+        const top = (screen.height - height) / 2;
+
+        window.open(
+            `/logistics/dispatch/${id}/print`,
+            'PrintDispatch',
+            `width=${width},height=${height},top=${top},left=${left},resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes`
+        );
+    }

+    function printDispatchLabels(id) {
+        const width = 800;

+        const top = (screen.height - height) / 2;
+
+        window.open(

+            'Print',
+            `width=${width},height=${height},top=${top},left=${left},resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes`
+        );
+    }

+    // --- Consolidated Report Logic ---
+    let searchDebounceTimer;
+
+    function debounceSearchGuides() {
+        clearTimeout(searchDebounceTimer);
+        searchDebounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
+            searchGuides();
+        }, 600);
+    }
+
+    function openConsolidatedModal() {
+        document.getElementById('consolidatedModal').style.display = 'flex';
+        // Set default date to today
+        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+        document.getElementById('consDateFrom').value = today;
+        document.getElementById('consDateTo').value = today;
+        document.getElementById('consGuideRef').value = '';
+
+        // Reset Views
+        document.getElementById('consGuideListContainer').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('consResultsContainer').style.display = 'none';
+
+        // Clear Report Data
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('consTableBody');
+        if (tbody) tbody.innerHTML = '';
+        document.getElementById('consTotalBoxes').textContent = '0';
+        document.getElementById('consTotalWeight').textContent = '0.00 kg';
+
+        document.getElementById('btnPrintConsolidated').style.display = 'none';
+
+        // Initial Search
+        searchGuides();
+    }
+
+    function closeConsolidatedModal() {
+        document.getElementById('consolidatedModal').style.display = 'none';
+    }
+
+    async function searchGuides() {
+        const guideRef = document.getElementById('consGuideRef').value.trim();
+        const dateFrom = document.getElementById('consDateFrom').value;
+        const dateTo = document.getElementById('consDateTo').value;
+
+        // Visual loading state if needed, or silent for debounce
+        // Let's toggle the button logic if it was clicked
+        // But for debounce we might skip it to avoid flickering
+
+        document.getElementById('consResultsContainer').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('consGuideListContainer').style.display = 'none';
+        document.getElementById('btnPrintConsolidated').style.display = 'none';
+
+        try {
+            const url = new URL('/logistics/api/guides/search', window.location.origin);
+            if (guideRef) url.searchParams.append('q', guideRef);
+            if (dateFrom) url.searchParams.append('date_from', dateFrom);
+            if (dateTo) url.searchParams.append('date_to', dateTo);
+
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const guides = await res.json();
+                renderGuideList(guides);
+            } else {
+                console.error("Search error");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderGuideList(guides) {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('consGuideListBody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+        const container = document.getElementById('consGuideListContainer');
+        container.style.display = 'block';
+
+        if (guides.length === 0) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center; padding:1rem;">No se encontraron guías.</td></tr>';
+            return;
+        }
+
+        guides.forEach(g => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);">${g.date}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-weight: 600;">${g.guide_number}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 0.85rem;">${g.client}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); text-align: center;">
+                    <button onclick="selectConsolidatedGuide('${g.document_ref}')" 
+                        class="btn" style="background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--primary); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.8rem;">
+                        Ver Reporte
+                    </button>
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }
+
+    async function selectConsolidatedGuide(guideRef) {
+        try {
+            const url = new URL('/logistics/api/consolidated_report', window.location.origin);
+            url.searchParams.append('guide_ref', guideRef);
+
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Error loading report");
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            // Hide List, Show Report
+            document.getElementById('consGuideListContainer').style.display = 'none';
+            renderConsolidatedReport(data);
+
+            // Set Print Context
+            document.getElementById('consolidatedModal').setAttribute('data-selected-guide', guideRef);
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error cargando reporte");
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderConsolidatedReport(data) {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('consTableBody');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        if (!data.details || data.details.length === 0) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center; padding: 1rem;">No se encontraron datos.</td></tr>';
+            document.getElementById('consTotalBoxes').textContent = '0';
+            document.getElementById('consTotalWeight').textContent = '0.00 kg';
+            return;
+        }
+
+        data.details.forEach(item => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);">${item.sku}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); text-align: center;">${item.total_units}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); text-align: center;">${item.total_boxes}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); text-align: center;">${item.total_weight.toFixed(2)} kg</td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 0.8rem; color: #666;">
+                    ${item.invoices.join(', ')}
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+
+
+        document.getElementById('consTotalBoxes').textContent = data.total_boxes_all;
+        document.getElementById('consTotalWeight').textContent = data.total_weight_all.toFixed(2) + ' kg';
+
+        // Update Invoice Count
+        document.getElementById('consTotalInvoices').textContent = data.total_invoices_count || 0;
+
+        if (data.total_amount_all) {
+            document.getElementById('consTotalAmount').textContent = parseFloat(data.total_amount_all).toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 });
+        } else {
+            document.getElementById('consTotalAmount').textContent = '0.00';
+        }
+
+        // Show print button and container if we have data
+        if (data.details && data.details.length > 0) {
+            document.getElementById('btnPrintConsolidated').style.display = 'inline-block';
+            document.getElementById('consResultsContainer').style.display = 'block';
+        }
+    }
+
+    function printConsolidatedReport() {
+        // Get selected guide from attribute
+        const guideRef = document.getElementById('consolidatedModal').getAttribute('data-selected-guide');
+
+        if (!guideRef) return;
+
+        // Extract number for pretty printing if needed, or pass full ref
+        const guideNum = guideRef.split('|')[0].trim();
+
+        const url = new URL('/logistics/consolidated_report/print', window.location.origin);
+        url.searchParams.append('guide_ref', guideNum);
+
+        const width = screen.availWidth;
+        const height = screen.availHeight;
+
+        window.open(
+            url.toString(),
+            'PrintConsolidated',
+            `width=${width},height=${height},top=0,left=0,resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes`
+        );
+    }

+<script>
+    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
+
+    // Init Date
+    $('dateInput').value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+
+    // --- Tab Logic ---
+    function switchTab(tabName) {
+        if (tabName === 'lines') {
+            $('tab-lines').style.display = 'block';
+            $('tab-other').style.display = 'none';
+        } else {
+            $('tab-lines').style.display = 'none';
+            $('tab-other').style.display = 'block';
+        }
+    }
+
+    // --- Data Store ---
+    let inventoryLines = [];
+    let articlesData = [];
+    let selectedIndex = -1;
+
+    // --- Load Articles ---
+    async function loadArticles() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/external/articles?category=inventory');
+            if (res.ok) articlesData = await res.json();
+        } catch (e) { console.error("Error loading articles", e); }
+    }
+    loadArticles();
+
+    // --- Search & Keyboard Navigation Logic ---
+    const searchInput = $('newArticleName');
+    const resultsDiv = $('searchResults');
+
+    // Helper to render dropdown
+    function renderResults(filtered) {
+        resultsDiv.innerHTML = '';
+        if (filtered.length > 0) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
+            filtered.forEach((item, index) => {
+                const div = document.createElement('div');
+                div.className = 'result-item';
+                div.textContent = `${item.code} - ${item.description}`;
+                div.onclick = () => selectArticle(item);
+                // Highlight logic
+                if (index === selectedIndex) div.classList.add('selected');
+                resultsDiv.appendChild(div);
+            });
+        } else {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    }
+
+    searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+        searchInput.classList.remove('is-invalid'); // Clear error
+        const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
+        selectedIndex = -1; // Reset selection
+        if (term.length < 2) { resultsDiv.style.display = 'none'; return; }
+
+        const filtered = articlesData.filter(a =>
+            a.description.toLowerCase().includes(term) || a.code.toLowerCase().includes(term)
+        );
+        // Limit results for performance
+        renderResults(filtered.slice(0, 10));
+    });
+
+    // Keyboard Navigation for Search
+    searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
+        const items = resultsDiv.getElementsByClassName('result-item');
+
+        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            if (items.length > 0) {
+                selectedIndex = (selectedIndex + 1) % items.length;
+                updateSelection(items);
+            }
+        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            if (items.length > 0) {
+                selectedIndex = (selectedIndex - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
+                updateSelection(items);
+            }
+        } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            if (selectedIndex >= 0 && items[selectedIndex]) {
+                items[selectedIndex].click(); // Simulate click
+            } else if (items.length > 0) {
+                items[0].click(); // Select first if none selected
+            }
+        }
+    });
+
+    function updateSelection(items) {
+        Array.from(items).forEach((item, index) => {
+            if (index === selectedIndex) {
+                item.classList.add('selected');
+                item.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
+            } else {
+                item.classList.remove('selected');
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function selectArticle(item) {
+        searchInput.value = item.description;
+        $('newArticleCode').value = item.code;
+        resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        searchInput.classList.remove('is-invalid');
+        $('newBatch').focus();
+    }
+
+    // --- Sequential Enter Logic ---
+    $('newBatch').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
+        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            $('newQty').focus();
+        }
+    });
+
+    $('newQty').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
+        $('newQty').classList.remove('is-invalid');
+        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+            e.preventDefault();
+            addLine();
+        }
+    });
+
+    // --- Add Line Logic ---
+    function addLine() {
+        const code = $('newArticleCode').value;
+        const name = searchInput.value;
+        const batch = $('newBatch').value;
+        const qty = parseFloat($('newQty').value);
+
+        let isValid = true;
+
+        if (!code || !name) {
+            searchInput.classList.add('is-invalid');
+            isValid = false;
+        }
+        if (isNaN(qty) || qty <= 0) {
+            $('newQty').classList.add('is-invalid');
+            isValid = false;
+        }
+
+        if (!isValid) return; // Stop if invalid
+
+        // Add to array
+        inventoryLines.push({
+            article_code: code,
+            article_description: name,
+            batch: batch || 'N/A',
+            quantity: qty
+        });
+
+        renderLines();
+        clearInputRow();
+        searchInput.focus(); // Jump back to start
+    }
+
+    function renderLines() {
+        // Remove existing non-input rows
+        const tbody = $('linesTableBody');
+        const rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('.data-row');
+        rows.forEach(r => r.remove());
+
+        // Append to end of table (Input Row is now at top)
+        inventoryLines.forEach((line, index) => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.className = 'data-row';
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td>${line.article_description} <span style='color:#999; font-size:0.8em;'>[${line.article_code}]</span></td>
+                <td>${line.batch}</td>
+                <td style="text-align: right;">${line.quantity.toFixed(2)}</td>
+                <td style="text-align: center;">
+                    <button type="button" onclick="removeLine(${index})" style="color: red; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer;">×</button>
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }
+
+    window.removeLine = function (index) {
+        inventoryLines.splice(index, 1);
+        renderLines();
+    }
+
+    function clearInputRow() {
+        searchInput.value = '';
+        $('newArticleCode').value = '';
+        $('newBatch').value = '';
+        $('newQty').value = '';
+        searchInput.classList.remove('is-invalid');
+        $('newQty').classList.remove('is-invalid');
+        selectedIndex = -1;
+    }
+
+    // --- Submit Logic ---
+    $('inventoryForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+        e.preventDefault();
+
+        if (inventoryLines.length === 0) {
+            alert("Agregue al menos una línea al inventario.");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const payload = {
+            date: $('dateInput').value,
+            notes: document.querySelector('input[name="notes"]').value,
+            lines: inventoryLines
+        };
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/inventory/api/full-capture', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                alert("Inventario guardado exitosamente (DOC #" + (await res.json()).correlative + ")");
+                window.location.reload();
+            } else {
+                const err = await res.json();
+                alert("Error al guardar: " + (err.detail || "Desconocido"));
+            }
+        } catch (error) {
+            console.error(error);
+            alert("Error de conexión");
+        }
+    });
+
+    // Close search on click outside
+    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+        if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsDiv.contains(e.target)) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+</script>
 {% endblock %}

+<script>
+    // State
+    let items = [];
+
+    // Init
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+        addItemRow(); // Start with one row
+    });
+
+    function renderItems() {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('itemsTableBody');
+        const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+
+        if (items.length === 0) {
+            emptyState.style.display = 'block';
+            return;
+        } else {
+            emptyState.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+
+        items.forEach((item, index) => {
+            const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+            tr.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <input type="text" value="${item.item}" oninput="updateItem(${index}, 'item', this.value)" 
+                        placeholder="Descripción del producto" 
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem;">
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <input type="number" value="${item.qty}" oninput="updateItem(${index}, 'qty', this.value)" 
+                        placeholder="0" 
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem;">
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem;">
+                    <select onchange="updateItem(${index}, 'unit', this.value)" 
+                        style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem;">
+                        <option value="Unid" ${item.unit === 'Unid' ? 'selected' : ''}>Unid</option>
+                        <option value="Kg" ${item.unit === 'Kg' ? 'selected' : ''}>Kg</option>
+                        <option value="Cjas" ${item.unit === 'Cjas' ? 'selected' : ''}>Cajas</option>
+                        <option value="Lts" ${item.unit === 'Lts' ? 'selected' : ''}>Litros</option>
+                    </select>
+                </td>
+                <td style="padding: 0.5rem; text-align: center;">
+                    <button type="button" onclick="removeItem(${index})" 
+                        style="background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--danger); cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.2rem; opacity: 0.6;">
+                        &times;
+                    </button>
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(tr);
+        });
+    }
+
+    function addItemRow() {
+        items.push({ item: '', qty: '', unit: 'Unid' });
+        renderItems();
+    }
+
+    function removeItem(index) {
+        items.splice(index, 1);
+        renderItems();
+    }
+
+    function updateItem(index, field, value) {
+        items[index][field] = value;
+    }
+
+    // Submit Handler
+    document.getElementById('receptionForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+        e.preventDefault();
+
+        // Validation
+        const validItems = items.filter(i => i.item.trim() !== '' && i.qty > 0);
+
+        if (validItems.length === 0) {
+            alert("⚠️ Por favor agrega al menos un ítem válido (Nombre y Cantidad > 0).");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const formData = new FormData(e.target);
+        // We only send valid items
+        formData.append('items', JSON.stringify(validItems));
+
+        try {
+            const btn = e.target.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
+            const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
+            btn.innerHTML = '⏳ Guardando...';
+            btn.disabled = true;
+
+            const res = await fetch('/logistics/reception/merchandise', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                // Success feedback
+                showSuccessModal();
+            } else {
+                alert("❌ Error al guardar la recepción.");
+                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
+                btn.disabled = false;
+            }
+        } catch (err) {
+            console.error(err);
+            alert("Error de conexión con el servidor.");
+        }
+    });
+</script>
+
+<!-- Success Modal -->
+<div id="successModal"
