+<script>
+    // Modal & Fetch Logic
+    let pendingOrders = [];
+
+    function openImportModal() {
+        document.getElementById('importModal').style.display = 'flex';
+        fetchPendingOrders();
+    }
+
+    function closeImportModal() {
+        document.getElementById('importModal').style.display = 'none';
+    }
+
+    async function fetchPendingOrders() {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('modalListBody');
+        const loading = document.getElementById('modalLoading');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+        loading.style.display = 'block';
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/logistics/api/production/pending`);
+            const data = await res.json();
+            pendingOrders = data;
+            renderModalList(data);
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            loading.style.display = 'none';
+            tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' style='text-align:center; color:red; padding: 1rem;'>Error cargando órdenes...</td></tr>";
+        }
+    }
+
+    function renderModalList(items) {
+        const tbody = document.getElementById('modalListBody');
+        const loading = document.getElementById('modalLoading');
+        tbody.innerHTML = '';
+        loading.style.display = 'none';
+
+        if (items.length === 0) {
+            tbody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' style='text-align:center; padding: 2rem; color: #6b7280;'>No hay órdenes pendientes.</td></tr>";
+            return;
+        }
+
+        items.forEach(order => {
+            const row = document.createElement("tr");
+            row.style.borderBottom = "1px solid #f3f4f6";
+            row.style.cursor = "pointer";
+            row.onmouseover = function () { this.style.backgroundColor = "#eff6ff"; };
+            row.onmouseout = function () { this.style.backgroundColor = "transparent"; };
+            row.onclick = () => selectOrder(order);
+
+            const orderNum = order.order_number ? String(order.order_number).padStart(8, '0') : order.id;
+
+            row.innerHTML = `
+                <td style="padding: 16px 24px; font-family: monospace; font-weight: 700; color: #2563eb;">#${orderNum}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 16px 24px; color: #111827;">${order.article_type}</td>
+                <td style="padding: 16px 24px; text-align: right; font-weight: 600;">${order.pt_units} Und</td>
+                <td style="padding: 16px 24px; text-align: center;">
+                    <button style="background-color: #4f46e5; color: white; border: none; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">SELECT</button>
+                </td>
+            `;
+            tbody.appendChild(row);
+        });
+    }
+
+    // Modal Search Filter removed
+    /*
+    document.getElementById('modalSearchInput').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+        const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
+        const filtered = pendingOrders.filter(o =>
+            (o.order_number && String(o.order_number).includes(term)) ||
+            (o.article_type && o.article_type.toLowerCase().includes(term))
+        );
+        renderModalList(filtered);
+    });
+    */
+
+    function selectOrder(order) {
+        // Unlock form
+        const card = document.getElementById('receptionCard');
+        card.style.opacity = '1';
+        card.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
+
+        document.getElementById('prodId').value = order.id;
+        document.getElementById('expectedUnits').value = order.pt_units;
+        document.getElementById('orderNumber').value = order.order_number;
+
+        document.getElementById('dispOrderNumber').value = order.order_number || order.id;
+        document.getElementById('dispProduct').value = order.article_type;
+        document.getElementById('dispExpected').value = order.pt_units;
+        document.getElementById('receivedQty').value = ''; // Clear previous
+
+        closeImportModal();
+        closeImportModal();
+        window.scrollTo(0, card.offsetTop);
+
+        // Fetch Box Equivalence
+        fetchArticleDetails(order.article_type);
+    }
+
+    let currentBoxEquiv = 0;
+
+    async function fetchArticleDetails(description) {
+        if (!description) return;
+        try {
+            // Re-use external articles API to find the article and get box_equiv
+            const res = await fetch('/api/external/articles');
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const articles = await res.json();
+                const found = articles.find(a => a.description === description);
+                if (found) {
+                    currentBoxEquiv = found.box_equiv || 0;
+                    calculateBoxes();
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error("Error fetching article details", e);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function calculateBoxes() {
+        const units = parseFloat(document.getElementById('receivedQty').value) || 0;
+        const boxesInput = document.getElementById('totalBoxes');
+
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0 && units > 0) {
+            boxesInput.value = (units / currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(2);
+        } else {
+            boxesInput.value = '';
+        }
+    }
+
+    document.getElementById('receivedQty').addEventListener('input', calculateBoxes);
+
+    function validateAndSubmit() {
+        const expected = parseFloat(document.getElementById('expectedUnits').value);
+        const received = parseFloat(document.getElementById('receivedQty').value);
+        const orderNum = document.getElementById('orderNumber').value;
+
+        if (isNaN(received)) {
+            alert("Ingrese la cantidad recibida");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const diff = expected - received;
+
+        if (diff !== 0) {
+            // Show Alert Modal
+            const body = document.getElementById('emailBody');
+            body.value = `Se detectó una diferencia en la Orden ${orderNum}.\n\nEsperado: ${expected}\nRecibido: ${received}\nDiferencia: ${diff}\n\nPor favor verificar.`;
+
+            document.getElementById('alertModal').style.display = 'flex';
+        } else {
+            // Submit directly
+            submitForm();
+        }
+    }
+
+    function closeModal() {
+        document.getElementById('alertModal').style.display = 'none';
+    }
+
+    async function submitForm(email = null) {
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('production_id', document.getElementById('prodId').value);
+        formData.append('received_qty', document.getElementById('receivedQty').value);
+        if (email) formData.append('alert_email', email);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/logistics/reception/confirm', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                showSuccessModal();
+            } else {
+                alert("Error: " + data.detail);
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert("Error de conexión");
+        }
+    }
+
+    function confirmWithAlert() {
+        const emailTo = document.getElementById('emailTo').value;
+        submitForm(emailTo);
+    }
+</script>
+
+<!-- Success Modal -->
+<div id="successModal"
+    style="display: none; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index: 9999; justify-content: center; align-items: center; backdrop-filter: blur(2px);">
+    <div class="card"
+        style="width: 400px; padding: 2rem; text-align: center; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); animation: slideIn 0.3s ease-out; background: white; border-radius: 8px;">
+        <div style="font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">✅</div>
+        <h2 style="margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; color: #16a34a;">Registro Guardado</h2>
+        <p style="color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">La información se ha guardado correctamente.</p>
+        <button onclick="closeSuccessAndReload()" class="btn"
+            style="width: 100%; justify-content: center; background: var(--odoo-primary); color: white; padding: 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;">Aceptar</button>
+    </div>
+</div>
+<script>
+    function showSuccessModal() {
+        document.getElementById('successModal').style.display = 'flex';
+    }
+    function closeSuccessAndReload() {
+        window.location.reload();
+    }
+</script>

 {% endblock %}

+        async function toggleAI(id, checkbox) {

+            const formData = new FormData();
+            formData.append('func_id', id);
+            formData.append('enabled', enabled);
+
+            try {
+                const res = await fetch('/maintenance/ai/toggle', {
+                    method: 'POST',
+                    body: formData
+                });
+                const data = await res.json();
+                if (data.status !== 'success') {
+                    alert('Error al cambiar estado');
+                    checkbox.checked = !enabled; // Revert
+                }
+            } catch (e) {
+                console.error(e);
+                alert('Error de conexión');
+                checkbox.checked = !enabled; // Revert
+            }
+        }

+<script>
+    // Init Dates
+    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
+        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+        const ps = document.getElementById('planStart');
+        const pe = document.getElementById('planEnd');
+        if (ps) ps.value = today;
+        if (pe) pe.value = today;
+
+        function valMaint() {
+            if (ps.value > pe.value) {
+                alert("Fecha inválida");
+                pe.value = ps.value;
+            }
+        }
+        if (ps) ps.addEventListener('change', valMaint);
+        if (pe) pe.addEventListener('change', valMaint);
+
+        // Init Production Dates too
+        const prs = document.getElementById('prodStart');
+        const pre = document.getElementById('prodEnd');
+        if (prs) prs.value = today;
+        if (pre) pre.value = today;
+    });
+
+
+
+    function resetFilters(table) {
+        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+        if (table === 'planning') {
+            document.getElementById('planStart').value = today;
+            document.getElementById('planEnd').value = today;
+        } else if (table === 'production') {
+            document.getElementById('prodStart').value = today;
+            document.getElementById('prodEnd').value = today;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function printReport(table) {
+        let url = `/maintenance/report/print?type=${table}`;
+        let s = '', e = '';
+
+        if (table === 'planning') {
+            s = document.getElementById('planStart').value;
+            e = document.getElementById('planEnd').value;
+        } else if (table === 'production') {
+            s = document.getElementById('prodStart').value;
+            e = document.getElementById('prodEnd').value;
+        }
+
+        if (s) url += `&start_date=${s}`;
+        if (e) url += `&end_date=${e}`;
+
+        window.open(url, '_blank');
+    }
+
+    function showTab(tabId, btn) {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
+        document.getElementById(tabId).style.display = 'block';
+
+        // Update active state
+        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
+        if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
+    }
+
+    function confirmDelete(type) {
+        const start = document.getElementById('planStart').value;
+        const end = document.getElementById('planEnd').value;
+
+        // Update hidden form inputs
+        document.getElementById('formPlanStart').value = start;
+        document.getElementById('formPlanEnd').value = end;
+
+        let msg = "¿ESTÁ SEGURO? Se borrarán las planificaciones";
+        if (start || end) {
+            msg += ` entre ${start || 'Inicio'} y ${end || 'Fin'}`;
+        } else {
+            msg += " DE TODAS LAS FECHAS";
+        }
+        return confirm(msg);
+    }
+
+
+
+    let currentTable = ''; // Store current table for deleteSelected
+
+    async function previewData(table) {
+        currentTable = table;
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('table', table);
+
+        if (table === 'planning') {
+            formData.append('start_date', document.getElementById('planStart').value);
+            formData.append('end_date', document.getElementById('planEnd').value);
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/preview', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            const container = document.getElementById('previewContainer');
+            const tableEl = document.getElementById('previewTable');
+            const thead = tableEl.querySelector('thead');
+            const tbody = tableEl.querySelector('tbody');
+
+            container.style.display = 'block';
+            tbody.innerHTML = '';
+            thead.innerHTML = '';
+
+            if (data.length === 0) {
+                tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td style="padding:1rem;">No se encontraron datos.</td></tr>';
+                return;
+            }
+
+            // Build Headers
+            let keys = Object.keys(data[0]);
+
+            // Reorder: id, date/created_at, inserted_at, others
+            const priority = ['id', 'date', 'created_at', 'inserted_at', 'article_type', 'article', 'batch_qty', 'kg_produced'];
+            keys.sort((a, b) => {
+                const idxA = priority.indexOf(a);
+                const idxB = priority.indexOf(b);
+                if (idxA !== -1 && idxB !== -1) return idxA - idxB;
+                if (idxA !== -1) return -1;
+                if (idxB !== -1) return 1;
+                return a.localeCompare(b);
+            });
+
+            const headerMap = {
+                'id': 'ID',
+                'date': 'Fecha Planificada',
+                'created_at': 'Fecha Asignada',
+                'inserted_at': 'Fecha Registro (System)',
+                'article_type': 'Artículo',
+                'article': 'Artículo',
+                'batch_qty': 'Batches',
+                'kg_produced': 'Kg Prod.',
+                'boxes': 'Cajas',
+                'pt_units': 'Unidades PT'
+            };
+
+            let headerRow = '<tr style="background:#f1f1f1; text-align:left;">';
+            headerRow += '<th style="padding:0.5rem; width: 30px;"><input type="checkbox" id="checkAll" onchange="toggleAll(this)"></th>';
+            keys.forEach(k => headerRow += `<th style="padding:0.5rem; white-space:nowrap;">${headerMap[k] || k}</th>`);
+            headerRow += '<th style="padding:0.5rem;">Acción</th>'; // Action Header
+            headerRow += '</tr>';
+            thead.innerHTML = headerRow;
+
+            // Build Rows
+            data.forEach(row => {
+                let tr = '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">';
+                tr += `<td style="padding:0.5rem;"><input type="checkbox" class="row-check" value="${row.id}" onchange="updateDeleteButton()"></td>`;
+                keys.forEach(k => {
+                    let content = row[k];
+                    if (content === null || content === undefined) content = "";
+                    let displayContent = content.toString();
+
+                    // Truncate logic handled by CSS, but we ensure tooltip has full content
+                    tr += `<td style="padding:0.5rem; white-space:nowrap; max-width: 150px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" title="${displayContent}">${displayContent}</td>`;
+                });
+
+                // Action Button
+                tr += `
+                <td style="padding:0.5rem;">
+                    <button onclick="deleteOne('${table}', '${row.id}')" 
+                        style="background: #dc3545; color: white; border: none; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">
+                        Eliminar
+                    </button>
+                </td>`;
+
+                tr += '</tr>';
+                tbody.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', tr);
+            });
+
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert('Error al cargar vista previa');
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function deleteOne(table, id) {
+        if (!confirm(`¿Eliminar registro ID: ${id}?`)) return;
+
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('table', table);
+        formData.append('action', 'one');
+        formData.append('id', id);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/delete', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData // Using FormData for standard form submission endpoint
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok) {
+                // Refresh preview
+                previewData(table);
+            } else {
+                alert("Error al eliminar");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error de conexión");
+        }
+    }
+
+
+    function toggleAll(source) {
+        const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.row-check');
+        checkboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = source.checked);
+        updateDeleteButton();
+    }
+
+    function updateDeleteButton() {
+        const checked = document.querySelectorAll('.row-check:checked');
+        const btn = document.getElementById('btnDeleteSelected');
+        const countSpan = document.getElementById('selectedCount');
+
+        countSpan.innerText = checked.length;
+
+        if (checked.length > 0) {
+            btn.disabled = false;
+            btn.style.opacity = '1';
+            btn.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+        } else {
+            btn.disabled = true;
+            btn.style.opacity = '0.5';
+            btn.style.cursor = 'not-allowed';
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function deleteSelected() {
+        const checked = document.querySelectorAll('.row-check:checked');
+        if (checked.length === 0) return;
+
+        const ids = Array.from(checked).map(cb => cb.value).join(',');
+
+        if (!confirm(`¿Eliminar los ${checked.length} registros seleccionados? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`)) return;
+
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('table', currentTable); // Use stored table
+        formData.append('action', 'list');
+        formData.append('ids', ids);
+
+        // Add dates to preserve context if backend needs it (though list delete usually ignores dates)
+        // Better safe to be simple. Backend relies on IDs.
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/delete', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+
+            if (res.ok || res.status === 303 || res.redirected) {
+                // Since fetch follows redirects automatically for 303 but returns the HTML of the new page, 
+                // we might want to manually reload or just call previewData again to refresh the table.
+                // But the backend returns a RedirectResponse to /maintenance?message=...
+                // Fetch will get that HTML. We can't easily change the browser URL and show the message without a full reload 
+                // or extracting the message. 
+                // Let's just reload the page to show the flash message or refresh the grid.
+                // Actually, resizing the grid is better UX, but we want the flash message "Se eliminaron X registros".
+                // If we use fetch, we lose the flash message if we don't handle it.
+                // Let's force a reload to the URL that the backend redirected to (if we can get it) 
+                // or just reload current page with a custom message if possible.
+                // Fetch 'res.url' should be the redirected URL.
+                window.location.href = res.url;
+            } else {
+                alert("Error al eliminar");
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error de conexión");
+        }
+    }
+</script>
 {% endblock %}

+    function openTab(evt, tabId) {

+        evt.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
+        evt.currentTarget.style.color = 'var(--text-current)';
+        evt.currentTarget.style.borderBottomColor = 'var(--primary)';
+        evt.currentTarget.style.fontWeight = '600';

+    function confirmDelete(type) {
+        if (type === 'planning') {
+            document.getElementById('formPlanStart').value = document.getElementById('planStart').value;
+            document.getElementById('formPlanEnd').value = document.getElementById('planEnd').value;
+        }

+    function printReport(table) {

+        if (table === 'planning') { s = document.getElementById('planStart').value; e = document.getElementById('planEnd').value; }
+        if (table === 'production') { s = document.getElementById('prodStart').value; e = document.getElementById('prodEnd').value; }

+        window.open(`/maintenance/report/print?type=${table}&start_date=${s}&end_date=${e}`, '_blank');
+    }

+    async function previewLogistics() {

+        formData.append('end_date', document.getElementById('logEnd').value);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/preview', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            renderTable(data, 'previewLogistics', table);
+        } catch (e) { alert("Error"); }
+    }

+    async function previewSupport() {
+        const formData = new FormData();

+        formData.append('start_date', document.getElementById('supStart').value);
+        formData.append('end_date', document.getElementById('supEnd').value);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/preview', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            renderTable(data, 'previewSupport', 'support_tickets');
+        } catch (e) { alert("Error"); }
+    }

+    // Creating a reusable render function since logic was repeated
+    function renderTable(data, containerId, tableType) {
+        let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.85rem;"><thead><tr style="background:#f1f5f9;">';
+
+        if (data.length === 0) {
+            html += '<td style="padding:1rem;">No se encontraron datos.</td></tr></table>';
+        } else {
+            // Checkbox Header
+            html += '<th style="padding:0.5rem; width: 40px;"><input type="checkbox" onclick="toggleAll(this)"></th>';
+
+            const keys = Object.keys(data[0]).filter(k => !['items_json', 'notes', '_sa_instance_state'].includes(k));
+            keys.forEach(k => html += `<th style="padding:0.5rem; text-align:left;">${k}</th>`);
+            html += '<th style="padding:0.5rem;">Acción</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
+
+            data.forEach(row => {
+                html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">';
+                // Checkbox Cell
+                html += `<td style="padding:0.5rem; text-align:center;"><input type="checkbox" class="row-selector" value="${row.id}"></td>`;
+
+                keys.forEach(k => html += `<td style="padding:0.5rem;">${row[k] === null ? '-' : row[k]}</td>`);
+                html += `<td style="padding:0.5rem;">
+                            <button onclick="deleteOne('${tableType}', '${row.id}')" style="color:var(--danger); border:none; background:none; cursor:pointer;">&times; Eliminar</button>
+                         </td></tr>`;
+            });
+            html += '</tbody></table>';
+        }
+        document.getElementById(containerId).innerHTML = html;
+    }
+
+    function toggleAll(source) {
+        document.querySelectorAll('.row-selector').forEach(cb => cb.checked = source.checked);
+    }
+
+    async function deleteSelected(scope) {
+        // scope used to know which table is active if needed, but here we assume 'logistics' tab mainly uses this
+        // or check which tab is visible
+        let table = '';
+        if (scope === 'logistics') {
+            table = document.getElementById('logTable').value;
+        } else if (scope === 'support') {
+            table = 'support_tickets';
+        } else {
+            // Fallback or others
+            return;
+        }
+
+        let previewContainer = scope === 'support' ? '#previewSupport' : '#previewLogistics';
+        const checkboxes = document.querySelector(previewContainer).querySelectorAll('.row-selector:checked');
+        if (checkboxes.length === 0) {
+            alert("Selecciona al menos un registro para eliminar.");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        if (!confirm(`¿Eliminar ${checkboxes.length} registros seleccionados?`)) return;
+
+        const ids = Array.from(checkboxes).map(cb => cb.value).join(',');
+
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        fd.append('table', table);
+        fd.append('action', 'list');
+        fd.append('ids', ids);
+
+        try {
+            await fetch('/maintenance/data/delete', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+            // Refresh
+            if (scope === 'logistics') previewLogistics();
+            else if (scope === 'support') previewSupport();
+            else alert("Actualiza la vista para ver cambios.");
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error al eliminar");
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function previewData(table) {
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('table', table);
+
+        if (table === 'planning') {
+            formData.append('start_date', document.getElementById('planStart').value);
+            formData.append('end_date', document.getElementById('planEnd').value);
+        } else if (table === 'production') {
+            formData.append('start_date', document.getElementById('prodStart').value);
+            formData.append('end_date', document.getElementById('prodEnd').value);
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/data/preview', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            renderTable(data, table === 'planning' ? 'previewPlanning' : 'previewProduction', table);
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Error al cargar datos");
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function deleteOne(table, id) {
+        if (!confirm(`¿Eliminar registro ID ${id}?`)) return;
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        // If tableType passed from renderTable was 'previewLogistics', we need actual table name
+        // Quick fix: renderTable receives the actual table name (e.g., 'inventory') or logic mapping
+        // In previous renderTable call: renderTable(data, 'previewLogistics', table); -> third arg IS table name
+
+        fd.append('table', table);
+        fd.append('action', 'one');
+        fd.append('id', id);
+
+        await fetch('/maintenance/data/delete', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+
+        // Refresh based on table type (naive refresh of active tab)
+        if (['planning', 'production'].includes(table)) previewData(table);
+        else if (table === 'support_tickets') previewSupport();
+        else previewLogistics();
+    }
+
+    async function toggleAI(id, checkbox) {
+        const enabled = checkbox.checked;
+        const formData = new FormData();
+        formData.append('func_id', id);
+        formData.append('enabled', enabled);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/ai/toggle', {
+                method: 'POST',
+                body: formData
+            });
+            const data = await res.json();
+            if (data.status !== 'success') {
+                alert('Error al cambiar estado');
+                checkbox.checked = !enabled; // Revert
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            alert('Error de conexión');
+            checkbox.checked = !enabled; // Revert
+        }
+    }
+    async function sendAIChat() {
+        const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
+        const history = document.getElementById('chatHistory');
+        const txt = input.value.trim();
+        if (!txt) return;
+
+        // User Message
+        history.innerHTML += `
+            <div style="align-self: flex-end; background: #8b5cf6; color: white; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 8px; max-width: 80%;">
+                ${txt}
+            </div>
+        `;
+        input.value = '';
+        history.scrollTop = history.scrollHeight;
+
+        const fd = new FormData();
+        fd.append('message', txt);
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/maintenance/ai/chat', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
+            const data = await res.json();
+
+            // AI Response
+            history.innerHTML += `
+                <div style="align-self: flex-start; background: #f1f5f9; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px 8px 8px 0; max-width: 80%;">
+                    ${data.response}
+                </div>
+            `;
+
+            // Auto-refresh if success
+            if (data.response.includes("exitosamente") || data.response.includes("agregado")) {
+                setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1500);
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            history.innerHTML += `
+                <div style="align-self: flex-start; background: #fee2e2; color: #dc2626; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px 8px 8px 0; max-width: 80%;">
+                    Error de conexión.
+                </div>
+            `;
+        }
+        history.scrollTop = history.scrollHeight;
+    }
+</script>

-    function getPresentationWeightKg() {

-        if (!match) return 0;

-        let unit = match[2];
-
-        if (isNaN(num)) return 0;
-
-        switch (unit) {
-            case 'g':
-            case 'gr':
-            case 'ml':
-            case 'cc': return num / 1000;
-            case 'kg':
-            case 'l': return num;
-            case 'ton': return num * 1000;
-            case 'lb': return num * 0.453592;
-            case 'oz': return num * 0.0283495;
-            default: return 0;
-        }
-    }

+<script>
+    // --- Global UI References (Declared at top to avoid TDZ) ---
+    const searchInput = document.getElementById('articleSearch');
+    const resultsDiv = document.getElementById('articleResults');
+    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('articleHidden');
+
+    // Form Inputs
+    const documentNumberInput = document.getElementById('documentNumber');
+    const batchInput = document.querySelector('input[name="batches"]');
+    const kgPerBatchInput = document.getElementById('kgPerBatch');
+    const totalKgInput = document.getElementById('totalKgInput');
+    const wastePercentageInput = document.getElementById('wastePercentageInput');
+
+    const presentationInput = document.getElementById('presentationInput');
+    const unitsInput = document.getElementById('unitsInput');
+    const boxesInput = document.getElementById('boxesInput');
+
+    // Search Correlative
+    const searchInputCorr = document.getElementById('searchCorrelative');
+    const searchSuggestions = document.getElementById('searchSuggestions');
+
+    // State
+    let articlesData = [];
+    let currentBoxEquiv = 0;
+
+    // --- Search & Edit Logic ---
+    async function searchPlan() {
+        const query = searchInputCorr.value;
+        if (!query) return;
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/api/planning/search?query=${query}`);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("No encontrado");
+            const plan = await res.json();
+            loadPlanIntoForm(plan);
+        } catch (e) {
+            alert("Documento no encontrado");
+        }
+    }
+
+    function loadPlanIntoForm(plan) {
+        // Set ID
+        document.getElementById('planId').value = plan.id;
+        documentNumberInput.value = plan.order_number.toString().padStart(8, '0');
+
+        // Populate Fields
+        searchInput.value = plan.article;
+        hiddenInput.value = plan.article;
+        batchInput.value = plan.batches;
+        document.querySelector('input[name="date"]').value = plan.date;
+        presentationInput.value = plan.presentation;
+        wastePercentageInput.value = plan.waste_percentage;
+        kgPerBatchInput.value = (plan.kg / plan.batches).toFixed(2);
+        totalKgInput.value = plan.kg;
+        unitsInput.value = plan.units;
+        boxesInput.value = plan.boxes;
+        document.querySelector('textarea[name="notes"]').value = plan.notes || "";
+
+        // UI State
+        setReadOnly(true);
+        document.getElementById('btnConfirm').style.display = 'none';
+
+        // Status Logic: Loaded = Green (Confirmed)
+        updateStatusUI('confirmed');
+    }
+
+    function updateStatusUI(state) {
+        const draft = document.getElementById('statusDraft');
+        const confirmed = document.getElementById('statusConfirmed');
+
+        // Reset classes
+        draft.classList.remove('active', 'status-red', 'status-yellow');
+        confirmed.classList.remove('active', 'status-green');
+
+        if (state === 'new') {
+            draft.classList.add('active', 'status-red');
+            document.getElementById('btnConfirm').style.display = 'inline-block';
+            document.getElementById('btnConfirm').textContent = "Confirmar";
+        } else if (state === 'edit') {
+            draft.classList.add('active', 'status-yellow');
+            document.getElementById('btnConfirm').style.display = 'inline-block';
+            document.getElementById('btnConfirm').textContent = "Guardar Cambios";
+        } else if (state === 'confirmed') {
+            confirmed.classList.add('active', 'status-green');
+        }
+    }
+
+    function setReadOnly(state) {
+        const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('#planningForm input:not(#searchCorrelative), #planningForm textarea');
+        inputs.forEach(input => {
+            if (input.id !== 'documentNumber') {
+                input.disabled = state;
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function enableEdit() {
+        const planId = document.getElementById('planId').value;
+        setReadOnly(false);
+        updateStatusUI(planId ? 'edit' : 'new');
+    }
+
+    // Navigation
+    async function navigateRecord(direction) {
+        const planId = document.getElementById('planId').value;
+        let url;
+
+        if (!planId) {
+            if (direction === 'prev') {
+                url = '/api/planning/latest';
+            } else {
+                return;
+            }
+        } else {
+            url = `/api/planning/${planId}/navigate?direction=${direction}`;
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(url);
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("No hay más registros");
+            const plan = await res.json();
+            loadPlanIntoForm(plan);
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.log("Navigation limit reached");
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Autocomplete Logic
+    searchInputCorr.addEventListener('input', async (e) => {
+        const val = e.target.value;
+        if (val.length < 1) {
+            searchSuggestions.style.display = 'none';
+            return;
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch(`/api/planning/autosuggest?query=${val}`);
+            if (res.ok) {
+                const data = await res.json();
+                if (data.length > 0) {
+                    searchSuggestions.innerHTML = '';
+                    data.forEach(item => {
+                        const div = document.createElement('div');
+                        div.style.padding = '8px';
+                        div.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                        div.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #eee';
+                        div.textContent = `Documento #${item.order_number}`;
+                        div.onmouseover = () => div.style.background = '#f9f9f9';
+                        div.onmouseout = () => div.style.background = 'white';
+                        div.onclick = () => {
+                            searchInputCorr.value = item.order_number;
+                            searchSuggestions.style.display = 'none';
+                            searchPlan();
+                        };
+                        searchSuggestions.appendChild(div);
+                    });
+                    searchSuggestions.style.display = 'block';
+                } else {
+                    searchSuggestions.style.display = 'none';
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
+    });
+
+    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+        if (!searchInputCorr.contains(e.target) && !searchSuggestions.contains(e.target)) {
+            searchSuggestions.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    searchInputCorr.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
+        if (e.key === 'Enter') searchPlan();
+    });
+
+    // Fetch Next Correlative ID
+    async function loadNextId() {
+        try {
+            const res = await fetch('/api/next-id/planning');
+            const data = await res.json();
+            const nextId = data.next_id || 1;
+            documentNumberInput.value = nextId.toString().padStart(8, '0');
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error("Failed to load next ID", e);
+            documentNumberInput.value = "00000000";
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Load Articles
+    async function loadArticles() {
+        try {
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Cargando artículos...";
+            const res = await fetch('/api/external/articles');
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error fetching articles');
+            articlesData = await res.json();
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Producto a construir...";
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error(e);
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Error conexión";
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Progressive Search Logic
+    searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+        const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
+        if (term.length < 1) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const filtered = articlesData.filter(a =>
+            a.description.toLowerCase().includes(term) || a.code.toLowerCase().includes(term)
+        );
+
+        if (filtered.length > 0) {
+            resultsDiv.innerHTML = '';
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
+            filtered.forEach(item => {
+                const div = document.createElement('div');
+                div.style.padding = '0.5rem';
+                div.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                div.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #eee';
+                div.textContent = `${item.code} - ${item.description}`;
+                div.onmouseover = () => div.style.background = '#f1f1f1';
+                div.onmouseout = () => div.style.background = 'white';
+
+                div.onclick = () => {
+                    selectArticle(item);
+                };
+                resultsDiv.appendChild(div);
+            });
+        } else {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    function selectArticle(item) {
+        searchInput.value = item.description;
+        hiddenInput.value = item.description;
+        resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+
+        // Store equivalence
+        currentBoxEquiv = item.box_equiv || 0;
+
+        // Smart Extraction
+        const regex = /(\d+(?:\.|,)?\d*\s*(?:g|kg|ml|l|cc|gr|lb|oz|ton)\b)/i;
+        const match = item.description.match(regex);
+
+        if (match) {
+            presentationInput.value = match[1].replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
+        } else {
+            presentationInput.value = "";
+        }
+
+        // Equivalence Feedback
+        const boxesHelper = document.getElementById('boxesHelper');
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0) {
+            boxesHelper.textContent = `(Factor: ${currentBoxEquiv} Und/Caja)`;
+            boxesHelper.style.color = '#16a34a'; // Green
+        } else {
+            boxesHelper.textContent = `(Factor: No definido)`;
+            boxesHelper.style.color = '#dc2626'; // Red
+        }
+
+        // Recalculate
+        calculateTotalKg();
+    }
+
+    // Calculators
+    function parseLocaleFloat(val) {
+        if (!val) return 0;
+        return parseFloat(val.toString().replace(',', '.')) || 0;
+    }
+
+    function calculateTotalKg() {
+        const batches = parseFloat(batchInput.value) || 0;
+        const kgBatch = parseLocaleFloat(kgPerBatchInput.value);
+        const wastePct = parseLocaleFloat(wastePercentageInput.value) || 0;
+
+        if (batches > 0 && kgBatch > 0) {
+            let grossTotal = batches * kgBatch;
+            let netTotal = grossTotal * (1 - (wastePct / 100));
+
+            totalKgInput.value = netTotal.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
+        }
+        calculateUnitsFromTotalKg();
+    }
+
+    batchInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotalKg);
+    kgPerBatchInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotalKg);
+    wastePercentageInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotalKg);
+
+    function getPresentationWeightKg() {
+        const val = presentationInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
+        const match = val.match(/([\d,\.]+)\s*(g|kg|ml|l|cc|gr|lb|oz|ton)\b/);
+
+        if (!match) return 0;
+
+        let num = parseFloat(match[1].replace(',', '.'));
+        let unit = match[2];
+
+        if (isNaN(num)) return 0;
+
+        switch (unit) {
+            case 'g':
+            case 'gr':
+            case 'ml':
+            case 'cc': return num / 1000;
+            case 'kg':
+            case 'l': return num;
+            case 'ton': return num * 1000;
+            case 'lb': return num * 0.453592;
+            case 'oz': return num * 0.0283495;
+            default: return 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function calculateUnitsFromTotalKg() {
+        const totalKg = parseLocaleFloat(totalKgInput.value);
+        const presKg = getPresentationWeightKg();
+
+        if (totalKg > 0 && presKg > 0) {
+            const units = Math.floor(totalKg / presKg);
+            unitsInput.value = units;
+            calculateBoxesFromUnits();
+        }
+    }
+
+    presentationInput.addEventListener('input', calculateUnitsFromTotalKg);
+
+    function calculateBoxesFromUnits() {
+        const units = parseFloat(unitsInput.value) || 0;
+
+        // Try to recover equiv if missing
+        if (currentBoxEquiv === 0) {
+            const currentDesc = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
+            const found = articlesData.find(a => a.description.toLowerCase() === currentDesc);
+            if (found) {
+                currentBoxEquiv = found.box_equiv || 0;
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0) {
+            boxesInput.value = (units / currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(2);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function calculateUnitsFromBoxes() {
+        const boxes = parseLocaleFloat(boxesInput.value);
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0 && boxes > 0) {
+            unitsInput.value = (boxes * currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(0);
+        }
+    }
+
+    boxesInput.addEventListener('input', calculateUnitsFromBoxes);
+    unitsInput.addEventListener('input', calculateBoxesFromUnits);
+
+    // Close dropdown
+    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
+        if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsDiv.contains(e.target)) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    function calculateUnitsFromBoxes() {
+        const boxes = parseLocaleFloat(boxesInput.value);
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0 && boxes > 0) {
+            unitsInput.value = (boxes * currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(0);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Close dropdown
+    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
+        if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsDiv.contains(e.target)) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    // Set default date to today
+    document.querySelector('input[name="date"]').valueAsDate = new Date();
+
+    loadArticles();
+    loadNextId();
+
+    document.getElementById('planningForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+        e.preventDefault();
+        const formData = new FormData(e.target);
+        const data = Object.fromEntries(formData.entries());
+
+        // Sanitization
+        if (!data.article || data.article.trim() === "") {
+            alert("Por favor, seleccione un producto válido.");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        try {
+            data.kg = parseLocaleFloat(data.kg);
+            data.boxes = parseLocaleFloat(data.boxes);
+            data.batches = parseInt(data.batches) || 0;
+            data.kg = parseLocaleFloat(data.kg);
+            data.boxes = parseLocaleFloat(data.boxes);
+            data.batches = parseInt(data.batches) || 0;
+            data.units = parseInt(data.units) || 0;
+            data.waste_percentage = parseLocaleFloat(data.waste_percentage);
+        } catch (err) {
+            alert("Error en formato de números");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const planId = document.getElementById('planId').value;
+        const method = planId ? 'PUT' : 'POST';
+        const url = planId ? `/api/planning/${planId}` : '/api/planning';
+
+        const response = await fetch(url, {
+            method: method,
+            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+            body: JSON.stringify(data)
+        });
+
+        if (response.ok) {
+            showSuccessModal();
+        } else {
+            alert('Error al guardar');
+        }
+    });
+</script>
+
+<!-- Success Modal -->
+<div id="successModal"
+    style="display: none; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index: 9999; justify-content: center; align-items: center; backdrop-filter: blur(2px);">
+    <div class="card"
+        style="width: 400px; padding: 2rem; text-align: center; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); animation: slideIn 0.3s ease-out; background: white; border-radius: 8px;">
+        <div style="font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">✅</div>
+        <h2 style="margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; color: #16a34a;">Registro Guardado</h2>
+        <p style="color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">La información se ha guardado correctamente.</p>
+        <button onclick="closeSuccessAndReload()" class="btn"
+            style="width: 100%; justify-content: center; background: var(--odoo-primary); color: white; padding: 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;">Aceptar</button>
+    </div>
+</div>

+        document.getElementById('successModal').style.display = 'flex';
+    }

+    async function loadArticles() {
+        const searchInput = document.getElementById('articleSearch');
+        try {
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Cargando datos...";
+            const res = await fetch('/api/external/articles');
+            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error');
+            articlesData = await res.json();
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Escriba para buscar artículo...";
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.error('API External Error:', e);
+            searchInput.placeholder = "Error cargando artículos";
+        }
+    }

+    // Progressive Search Logic
+    const searchInput = document.getElementById('articleSearch');
+    const resultsDiv = document.getElementById('articleResults');
+    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('articleTypeHidden');
+
+    searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+        const term = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
+        if (term.length < 1) {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const filtered = articlesData.filter(a =>
+            a.description.toLowerCase().includes(term) || a.code.toLowerCase().includes(term)
+        );
+
+        if (filtered.length > 0) {
+            resultsDiv.innerHTML = '';
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
+            filtered.forEach(item => {
+                const div = document.createElement('div');
+                div.style.padding = '0.5rem';
+                div.style.cursor = 'pointer';
+                div.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #eee';
+                div.textContent = `${item.code} - ${item.description}`;
+                div.onmouseover = () => div.style.background = '#f1f1f1';
+                div.onmouseout = () => div.style.background = 'white';
+
+                div.onclick = () => {
+                    selectArticle(item);
+                };
+                resultsDiv.appendChild(div);
+            });
+        } else {
+            resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+        }
+    });
+
+    let currentBoxEquiv = 0;
+
+    function selectArticle(item) {
+        searchInput.value = item.description;
+        hiddenInput.value = item.description;
+        resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
+
+        // Auto-fill logic
+        document.getElementById('baseUnit').value = item.unit;
+        if (item.unit) {
+            document.getElementById('consType').value = item.unit;
+        }
+
+        currentBoxEquiv = item.box_equiv || 0;
+
+        // Smart Extraction for Presentation (e.g., "BOLSA 600g")
+        const regex = /(\d+(?:\.|,)?\d*\s*(?:g|kg|ml|l|cc|gr|lb|oz|ton)\b)/i;
+        const match = item.description.match(regex);
+
+        const presentationInput = document.getElementById('presentationInput');
+        if (match) {
+            presentationInput.value = match[1].replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
+        } else {
+            presentationInput.value = "";
+        }
+
+        // Recalculate everything based on new article/presentation
+        calculateUnitsFromTotalKg();
+    }
+
+    // Presentation Parser
+    function getPresentationWeightKg() {
+        const val = document.getElementById('presentationInput').value.trim().toLowerCase();
+        // Regex for number + unit
+        const match = val.match(/([\d,\.]+)\s*(g|kg|ml|l|cc|gr|lb|oz|ton)\b/);
+
+        if (!match) return 0;
+
+        let num = parseFloat(match[1].replace(',', '.'));
+        let unit = match[2];
+
+        if (isNaN(num)) return 0;
+
+        switch (unit) {
+            case 'g':
+            case 'gr':
+            case 'ml':
+            case 'cc': return num / 1000;
+            case 'kg':
+            case 'l': return num;
+            case 'ton': return num * 1000;
+            case 'lb': return num * 0.453592;
+            case 'oz': return num * 0.0283495;
+            default: return 0;
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Kg Calculator
+    const batchInput = document.querySelector('input[name="batch_qty"]');
+    const kgPerBatchInput = document.getElementById('kgPerBatch');
+    const totalKgInput = document.getElementById('totalKgInput');
+
+    function parseLocaleFloat(val) {
+        if (!val) return 0;
+        return parseFloat(val.toString().replace(',', '.')) || 0;
+    }
+
+    function calculateTotalKg() {
+        const batches = parseFloat(batchInput.value) || 0;
+        const kgBatch = parseLocaleFloat(kgPerBatchInput.value);
+        if (batches > 0 && kgBatch > 0) {
+            // Apply Waste Deduction logic from Planning
+            const wastePct = parseFloat(document.getElementById('wastePercentageHidden').value) || 0;
+            let grossTotal = batches * kgBatch;
+            let netTotal = grossTotal * (1 - (wastePct / 100));
+
+            totalKgInput.value = netTotal.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
+        }
+        calculateUnitsFromTotalKg();
+    }
+
+    batchInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotalKg);
+    kgPerBatchInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotalKg);
+    document.getElementById('presentationInput').addEventListener('input', calculateUnitsFromTotalKg);
+
+    // Calculation Logic: Bidirectional Boxes <-> Units
+    const boxesInput = document.getElementById('boxesInput');
+    const unitsInput = document.getElementById('unitsInput');
+
+    // Triggered when Total Kg changes
+    function calculateUnitsFromTotalKg() {
+        const totalKg = parseLocaleFloat(totalKgInput.value);
+        const presKg = getPresentationWeightKg();
+
+        if (totalKg > 0 && presKg > 0) {
+            const units = Math.floor(totalKg / presKg);
+            unitsInput.value = units;
+            calculateBoxesFromUnits();
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Triggered when Units manually changed
+    // Triggered when Units manually changed
+    function calculateBoxesFromUnits() {
+        const units = parseFloat(unitsInput.value) || 0;
+
+        // Try to find equiv if missing (e.g. manual entry or loaded form)
+        if (currentBoxEquiv === 0) {
+            const currentDesc = document.getElementById('articleSearch').value.trim();
+            if (currentDesc && articlesData.length > 0) {
+                // Case insensitive match
+                const found = articlesData.find(a => a.description.toLowerCase() === currentDesc.toLowerCase());
+                if (found) currentBoxEquiv = found.box_equiv || 0;
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0) {
+            boxesInput.value = (units / currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(2);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Triggered when Boxes manually changed
+    function calculateUnitsFromBoxes() {
+        const boxes = parseLocaleFloat(boxesInput.value);
+        if (currentBoxEquiv > 0 && boxes > 0) {
+            unitsInput.value = (boxes * currentBoxEquiv).toFixed(0);
+        }
+    }
+
+    boxesInput.addEventListener('input', calculateUnitsFromBoxes);
+    unitsInput.addEventListener('input', calculateBoxesFromUnits);
+
+    // Close dropdown when clicking outside
+    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
+        if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !resultsDiv.contains(e.target)) {

+    // Consumo Rapido Calculator

+        const count = parseLocaleFloat(consCountInput.value);
+        const unitWeight = parseLocaleFloat(consUnitWeightInput.value);
+        if (count > 0 && unitWeight > 0) {

+        }
+    }

+    document.getElementById('productionForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+        e.preventDefault();
+        const form = e.target;
+        const formData = new FormData(form);
+
+        // Ensure Article Type is set (fallback to search text)
+        if (!formData.get('article_type') || formData.get('article_type').trim() === '') {
+            const searchText = document.getElementById('articleSearch').value;
+            if (searchText) {
+                formData.set('article_type', searchText);
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Client-side validation/formatting if needed
+        // Note: FormData values are strings/blobs. The backend FastApi Form features will cast them.
+        // However, we might want to ensure dots instead of commas for floats before sending?
+        // Or simply trust the backend to handle standard float string if locale matches?
+        // Let's replace comma with dot in formData for float fields to be safe
+
+        const floatFields = ['kg_produced', 'boxes', 'cons_count', 'cons_unit_weight', 'cons_qty', 'mp_waste_kg'];
+
+        for (const field of floatFields) {
+            const val = formData.get(field);
+            // Replace comma, and ensure not empty string
+            if (val && typeof val === 'string') {
+                const cleaned = val.replace(',', '.');
+                if (cleaned.trim() === '') {
+                    formData.set(field, "0");
+                } else {
+                    formData.set(field, cleaned);
+                }
+            } else if (!val) {
+                // If null or empty, send 0
+                formData.set(field, "0");
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Sanitize Integers as well
+        const intFields = ['batch_qty', 'pt_units', 'pt_lab', 'pt_burned', 'mp_containers', 'mp_caps_clean', 'mp_caps_dirty'];
+        for (const field of intFields) {
+            const val = formData.get(field);
+            if (!val || val.toString().trim() === '') {
+                formData.set(field, "0");
+            }
+        }
+
+        try {
+            const id = document.getElementById('reportId').value;
+            const method = id ? 'PUT' : 'POST';
+            const url = id ? `/api/production/${id}` : '/api/production';
+
+            let body;
+            let headers = {};
+
+            if (method === 'POST') {
+                body = formData;
+            } else {
+                const obj = {};
+                formData.forEach((value, key) => {
+                    // Exclude File objects (images) from JSON update
+                    if (value instanceof File) return;
+                    obj[key] = value;
+                });
+                body = JSON.stringify(obj);
+                headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
+            }
+
+            const response = await fetch(url, {
+                method: method,
+                headers: headers,
+                body: body
+            });
+
+            if (response.ok) {
+                // Remove alert and immediate reload
+                form.reset();
+                document.getElementById('totalKgInput').value = '';
+                document.getElementById('consTotalWeight').value = '';
+
+                showSuccessModal();
+            } else {
+                let errorMsg = 'Error desconocido';
+                try {
+                    // Read text first to avoid 'body stream already read'
+                    const text = await response.text();
+                    try {
+                        const err = JSON.parse(text);
+                        errorMsg = JSON.stringify(err.detail || err);
+                    } catch (e) {
+                        // Not JSON, use text
+                        errorMsg = text || response.statusText;
+                    }
+                } catch (readErr) {
+                    errorMsg = "Error leyendo respuesta del servidor";
+                }
+                alert('Error al guardar reporte (' + response.status + '): ' + errorMsg);
+            }
+        } catch (error) {
+            console.error(error);
+            alert('Error de conexión o red: ' + error.message);
+        }
+    });

+<script>
+    // Modal Logic
+    const modal = document.getElementById("planningModal");
+    const modalBody = document.getElementById("planningModalBody");
+    const loadingDiv = document.getElementById("planningLoading");
+
+    function openPlanningModal() {
+        modal.style.display = "block";
+        // Disable scrolling on body
+        document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
+        fetchPendingPlans();
+    }
+
+    function closePlanningModal() {
+        modal.style.display = "none";
+        document.body.style.overflow = "auto";
+    }
+
+    window.onclick = function (event) {
+        if (event.target == modal) {
+            closePlanningModal();
+        }
+    }
+
+    async function fetchPendingPlans() {
+        modalBody.innerHTML = "";
+        loadingDiv.style.display = "block";
+
+        try {
+            const response = await fetch('/api/planning/pending');
+            const plans = await response.json();
+            loadingDiv.style.display = "none";
+
+            if (plans.length === 0) {
+                modalBody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' style='text-align:center; padding: 3rem; color: #6b7280;'>No hay órdenes de planificación pendientes.</td></tr>";
+                return;
+            }
+
+            plans.forEach(plan => {
+                const row = document.createElement("tr");
+                row.style.borderBottom = "1px solid #f3f4f6";
+                row.style.cursor = "pointer";
+                row.style.transition = "background-color 0.15s";
+                row.onmouseover = function () { this.style.backgroundColor = "#eff6ff"; };
+                row.onmouseout = function () { this.style.backgroundColor = "transparent"; };
+                row.onclick = function () { selectPlanningOrder(plan); };
+
+                const idClean = plan.label.split(" - ")[0].replace('#', '');
+
+                // Calculate Pending Batches for Display
+                let displayQty = `${plan.units} unid`; // Fallback
+                if (plan.total_units && plan.batches && plan.batches > 0) {
+                    const unitsPerBatch = plan.total_units / plan.batches;
+                    const pBatches = (plan.units / unitsPerBatch).toFixed(2);
+                    displayQty = `${parseFloat(pBatches)} batches`; // parseFloat to remove unnecessary decimals
+                }
+
+                row.innerHTML = `
+                        <td style="padding: 16px 24px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-weight: 700; color: #2563eb;">#${idClean}</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 16px 24px; color: #111827; font-weight: 500;">${plan.article}</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 16px 24px; text-align: right; color: #374151; font-weight: 600;">
+                            <span style="background-color: #ecfdf5; color: #047857; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem;">${displayQty}</span>
+                        </td>
+                        <td style="padding: 16px 24px; text-align: center;">
+                            <button style="
+                                background-color: #4f46e5; 
+                                color: white; 
+                                border: none; 
+                                padding: 6px 12px; 
+                                border-radius: 4px; 
+                                font-size: 0.75rem; 
+                                font-weight: 600; 
+                                text-transform: uppercase; 
+                                letter-spacing: 0.05em; 
+                                cursor: pointer; 
+                                box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
+                                transition: background-color 0.2s;
+                            " 
+                            onmouseover="this.style.backgroundColor='#4338ca'"
+                            onmouseout="this.style.backgroundColor='#4f46e5'">
+                                <span style="margin-right:4px;">CLICK</span>
+                            </button>
+                        </td>
+                    `;
+                modalBody.appendChild(row);
+            });
+
+        } catch (error) {
+            console.error("Error fetching plans:", error);
+            loadingDiv.style.display = "none";
+            modalBody.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' style='text-align:center; padding: 2rem; color: #ef4444;'>Error al cargar los datos</td></tr>";
+        }
+    }
+
+    function selectPlanningOrder(plan) {
+        // Populate Form
+        document.getElementById('planningSearch').value = plan.label;
+        document.getElementById('planningOrderIdHidden').value = plan.id;
+        document.getElementById('wastePercentageHidden').value = plan.waste_percentage || 0;
+
+        // Auto-fill Article
+        document.getElementById('articleSearch').value = plan.article;
+        document.getElementById('articleTypeHidden').value = plan.article;
+
+        // Auto-fill Quantity (Batches)
+        // Logic: Calculate ratio (Total Units / Total Batches) = Units per Batch
+        // Then: Pending Units / Units per Batch = Pending Batches
+        let pendingBatches = 0;
+        if (plan.total_units && plan.batches && plan.batches > 0) {
+            const unitsPerBatch = plan.total_units / plan.batches;
+            pendingBatches = (plan.units / unitsPerBatch).toFixed(2); // plan.units here is 'pending_units' from API
+            // Handle edge case if result is NaN/Infinite
+            if (!isFinite(pendingBatches)) pendingBatches = 0;
+        } else {
+            // Fallback if data missing
+            pendingBatches = 0;
+        }
+
+        const qtyInput = document.querySelector('input[name="batch_qty"]');
+        qtyInput.value = parseFloat(pendingBatches); // Remove trailing zeros if integer
+        qtyInput.placeholder = "0.00";
+
+        // Auto-fill Presentation if available
+        if (plan.presentation) {
+            document.getElementsByName('presentation')[0].value = plan.presentation;
+        }
+
+        closePlanningModal();
+    }
+</script>

+            if (intervalInvoices) clearInterval(intervalInvoices);
+            loadInvoices(); // Initial load

+        }
+    }

+{% block scripts %}
+<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.0.min.js"></script>
+<script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
+<script>
+    let tablaTiempoReal = null;
+    let tablaDetalle = null;
+    let intervaloTiempoReal = null;
+
+    $(document).ready(function () {
+        // Inicializar DataTable para tiempo real
+        tablaTiempoReal = $('#tablaTiempoReal').DataTable({
+            "data": [],
+            "columns": [
+                { "data": "NumeroTraslado" },
+                { "data": "Fecha" },
+                { "data": "AlmacenOrigen" },
+                { "data": "AlmacenDestino" },
+                {
+                    "data": "Confirmado",
+                    "render": function (data) {
+                        if (data === 'SI') {
+                            return '<span style="color:var(--success); font-weight:600;">Confirmado</span>';
+                        } else {
+                            return '<span style="color:var(--danger); font-weight:600;">Pendiente</span>';
+                        }
+                    }
+                },
+                { "data": "CantidadArticulos" },
+                {
+                    "data": "NumeroTraslado",
+                    "render": function (data) {
+                        return `<button onclick="verDetalle('${data.trim()}')" class="btn" style="padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.8rem;">Ver</button>`;
+                    }
+                }
+            ],
+            "language": { "url": "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.7/i18n/es-ES.json" },
+            "pageLength": 25,
+            "dom": "tp"
+        });
+
+        // Iniciar actualización automática
+        iniciarAutoActualizacion();
+    });
+
+    function cargarDatosTiempoReal() {
+        $.ajax({
+            url: '/api/traslados/tiempo-real',
+            success: function (data) {
+                tablaTiempoReal.clear().rows.add(data).draw();
+                document.getElementById('ultimaActualizacion').textContent =
+                    'Última actualización: ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
+            },
+            error: function () {
+                console.error("Error al cargar traslados en tiempo real.");
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function iniciarAutoActualizacion() {
+        if (intervaloTiempoReal) clearInterval(intervaloTiempoReal);
+        intervaloTiempoReal = setInterval(cargarDatosTiempoReal, 10000);
+        cargarDatosTiempoReal(); // Cargar inmediatamente
+    }
+
+    function detenerAutoActualizacion() {
+        if (intervaloTiempoReal) {
+            clearInterval(intervaloTiempoReal);
+            intervaloTiempoReal = null;
+        }
+    }
+
+    function verDetalle(tras_num) {
+        document.getElementById('modalTitulo').textContent = tras_num;
+        $('#modalDetalle').show();
+
+        // Destroy previous
+        try {
+            if ($.fn.dataTable.isDataTable('#tablaDetalle')) {
+                $('#tablaDetalle').DataTable().clear().destroy();
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.warn(e);
+        }
+
+        // Initialize with AJAX data fetch
+        window.tablaDetalle = $('#tablaDetalle').DataTable({
+            "processing": true,
+            "serverSide": false,
+            "ajax": {
+                "url": "/api/traslados/detalle",
+                "data": { tras_num: tras_num },
+                "dataSrc": ""
+            },
+            "columns": [
+                { "data": "NroLote" },
+                { "data": "CodigoArticulo" },
+                { "data": "DescripcionArticulo" },
+                { "data": "Fecha" },
+                { "data": "AlmacenOrigen" },
+                { "data": "AlmacenDestino" },
+                {
+                    "data": "Confirmado",
+                    "render": function (data) {
+                        return data === 'SI' ? '<span style="color:var(--success)">SI</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--danger)">NO</span>';
+                    }
+                }
+            ],
+            "language": { "url": "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.7/i18n/es-ES.json" },
+            "destroy": true,
+            "pageLength": 10,
+            "dom": "tp"
+        });
+    }
+
+    function cerrarModal() {
+        $('#modalDetalle').hide();
+    }
+
+    // Close modal on outside click
+    window.onclick = function (event) {
+        if (event.target == document.getElementById('modalDetalle')) {
+            cerrarModal();
+        }
+    }
+</script>
 {% endblock %}

+{% block scripts %}
+<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.0.min.js"></script>
+<script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
+<script>
+    let tablaCabecera = null;
+    let tablaDetalle = null;
+
+    $(document).ready(function () {
+        // Inicializar DataTable para cabecera
+        tablaCabecera = $('#tablaCabecera').DataTable({
+            "data": [],
+            "columns": [
+                { "data": "NumeroTraslado" },
+                { "data": "Fecha" },
+                { "data": "AlmacenOrigen" },
+                { "data": "AlmacenDestino" },
+                {
+                    "data": "Confirmado",
+                    "render": function (data) {
+                        if (data === 'SI') {
+                            return '<span style="color:var(--success); font-weight:600;">Confirmado</span>';
+                        } else {
+                            return '<span style="color:var(--danger); font-weight:600;">Pendiente</span>';
+                        }
+                    }
+                },
+                { "data": "CantidadArticulos" },
+                {
+                    "data": "NumeroTraslado",
+                    "render": function (data) {
+                        return `<button onclick="verDetalle('${data}')" class="btn" style="padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.8rem;">Ver</button>`;
+                    }
+                }
+            ],
+            "language": { "url": "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.7/i18n/es-ES.json" },
+            "pageLength": 25,
+            "dom": "tp" // Simple layout
+        });
+
+        // Tab Handling
+        $('.filter-tab').click(function () {
+            $('.filter-tab').css({ 'border-bottom': 'none', 'color': 'var(--text-muted)' });
+            $(this).css({ 'border-bottom': '2px solid var(--primary)', 'color': 'var(--primary)' });
+        });
+
+        // Date Validation
+        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+        const dStart = document.getElementById('fecha_desde');
+        const dEnd = document.getElementById('fecha_hasta');
+
+        if (dStart && !dStart.value) dStart.value = today;
+        if (dEnd && !dEnd.value) dEnd.value = today;
+
+        function validateTrasRules() {
+            if (dStart.value && dEnd.value && dStart.value > dEnd.value) {
+                alert("Fecha inválida: La fecha final no puede ser menor a la inicial.");
+                dEnd.value = dStart.value;
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (dStart) dStart.addEventListener('change', validateTrasRules);
+        if (dEnd) dEnd.addEventListener('change', validateTrasRules);
+
+        cargarAlmacenes();
+    });
+
+    function cargarAlmacenes() {
+        $.ajax({
+            url: '/api/traslados/almacenes', /* Adjusted API URL to be routed via traslados router */
+            success: function (data) {
+                const select = document.getElementById('alm_dest');
+                data.forEach(item => {
+                    const option = document.createElement('option');
+                    option.value = item.codigo;
+                    option.textContent = `${item.codigo} - ${item.nombre}`;
+                    select.appendChild(option);
+                });
+            },
+            error: function () {
+                // alert("Error al cargar los almacenes.");
+                console.error("Error al cargar almacenes");
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function cargarCabecera() {
+        const alm_dest = document.getElementById('alm_dest').value || '';
+        const fecha_desde = document.getElementById('fecha_desde').value || '';
+        const fecha_hasta = document.getElementById('fecha_hasta').value || '';
+
+        // Allow search without filters if user wants all? Usually heavy. 
+        // Let's require at least one or strict warnings.
+        // The original code required one.
+        if (!alm_dest && !fecha_desde && !fecha_hasta) {
+            alert("Ingrese al menos un filtro.");
+            return;
+        }
+
+        $.ajax({
+            url: '/api/traslados/cabecera',
+            data: { alm_dest, fecha_desde, fecha_hasta },
+            success: function (data) {
+                tablaCabecera.clear().rows.add(data).draw();
+            },
+            error: function () {
+                alert("Error al cargar la cabecera.");
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function limpiarFiltros() {
+        document.getElementById('alm_dest').value = '';
+        document.getElementById('fecha_desde').value = '';
+        document.getElementById('fecha_hasta').value = '';
+        tablaCabecera.clear().draw();
+        // Reset active tab to 'Todos'
+        $('.filter-tab').css({ 'border-bottom': 'none', 'color': 'var(--text-muted)' });
+        $('.filter-tab:first').css({ 'border-bottom': '2px solid var(--primary)', 'color': 'var(--primary)' });
+    }
+
+    function filtrarConfirmado(valor) {
+        tablaCabecera.column(4).search(valor).draw();
+    }
+
+    function verDetalle(tras_num) {
+        tras_num = String(tras_num || '').trim();
+        document.getElementById('modalTitulo').textContent = tras_num;
+        $('#modalDetalle').show();
+
+        // Mostrar spinner
+        const spinner = document.getElementById('modalSpinner');
+        spinner.style.display = 'block';
+
+        // Destroy previous
+        try {
+            if ($.fn.dataTable.isDataTable('#tablaDetalle')) {
+                $('#tablaDetalle').DataTable().clear().destroy();
+            }
+        } catch (e) {
+            console.warn(e);
+        }
+        $('#tablaDetalle tbody').empty();
+
+        $.ajax({
+            url: '/api/traslados/detalle',
+            method: 'GET',
+            dataType: 'json',
+            cache: false,
+            data: { tras_num: tras_num },
+            success: function (data) {
+                spinner.style.display = 'none';
+
+                tablaDetalle = $('#tablaDetalle').DataTable({
+                    data: data,
+                    "columns": [
+                        { "data": "NroLote" },
+                        { "data": "Fecha" },
+                        { "data": "AlmacenOrigen" },
+                        { "data": "AlmacenDestino" },
+                        { "data": "CodigoArticulo" },
+                        { "data": "DescripcionArticulo" },
+                        {
+                            "data": "Confirmado",
+                            "render": function (data) {
+                                return data === 'SI' ? '<span style="color:var(--success)">SI</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--danger)">NO</span>';
+                            }
+                        }
+                    ],
+                    "language": { "url": "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.7/i18n/es-ES.json" },
+                    "destroy": true,
+                    "pageLength": 10,
+                    "dom": "tp"
+                });
+            },
+            error: function () {
+                spinner.style.display = 'none';
+                $('#tablaDetalle tbody').html('<tr><td colspan="7" style="padding:12px; text-align:center; color:var(--danger);">Error al cargar detalle (ver consola).</td></tr>');
+                console.error('Error al cargar /api/traslados/detalle');
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    function cerrarModal() {
+        $('#modalDetalle').hide();
+        if (window.tablaDetalle) window.tablaDetalle.destroy();
+    }
+
+    // Close modal on outside click
+    window.onclick = function (event) {
+        if (event.target == document.getElementById('modalDetalle')) {
+            cerrarModal();
+        }
+    }
+</script>
 {% endblock %}

+    function updateTime() {
+        const now = new Date();
+        document.getElementById('clock').textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
+        document.getElementById('date').textContent = now.toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });
